subject: Client filed a chargeback on an invoice
body: Hello, one of our clients has filed a chargeback with their card issuer for a $1,192 payment they made through our Tallyfern invoice. The work was delivered and they signed off on it, so we want to contest this. What evidence do you need from us, and is there a deadline we should know about? Thank you, Marisol at Brightline Studio

subject: Request for a copy of our data
body: Hi. We'd like a full export of all personal and account data you hold about our company and our six users. Please send it in a machine-readable format. Who do I send the formal request to, and how long will it take? Thanks, Jonas

subject: Refund for an add-on we didn't need
body: Hello, 22 days ago we were charged $544 for the advanced reporting add-on across our workspace. Our finance lead thought it was included in our enterprise contract, and it turns out we already get the same reports from our own BI tool, so nobody has opened it since. We'd like to request a refund of the $544 and have the add-on removed from our account so it doesn't renew. Happy to jump on a call if that helps. Best regards, Daniel Okafor, Operations, Halvorsen Logistics

subject: Bank dispute opened on our subscription charge
body: Hi Tallyfern team, I'm writing on behalf of Kestrel Physio, a group of three clinics. Back on July 9, our account was charged $2,484 for what looked like a full year of the Pro plan plus extra seats. At the time we couldn't match it to anything we had approved, and our bookkeeper, who was covering for me while I was on leave, opened a dispute with our bank about it. Now that I'm back I can see the charge was probably legitimate, because we did add seats in June. I don't want this to become a mess or for our account to be suspended. Can you tell me what happens next with the dispute, whether we should withdraw it on our side, and what you need from us to sort it out? Kind regards, Aroha Ngata

subject: Someone logged into our account!!
body: We just got an alert that someone signed in to our Tallyfern account from a country none of us have ever been to, and now there are two invoices in drafts that NOBODY here created. I've changed my password but I have no idea what else they touched. Lock this down NOW and tell me what they accessed. Furious, Lena Vogt

subject: v1 API returning 500 errors
body: Our integration on the v1 API started returning 500 errors on POST /v1/invoices about an hour ago. Nothing changed on our side. Same payloads worked yesterday. We create roughly forty invoices a day through it. Request IDs available if needed. Please advise. Sam, Northgate Supply

subject: How to export the audit log
body: How do I export the full audit log for the last 90 days? Need it as CSV. Separately, one of our admins says she got a Tallyfern login prompt by email this morning that looked off. The link went to a strange domain and she entered her password before noticing. Not sure if that matters. Thanks, Graham

subject: Adding another department to our plan
body: Good afternoon, we're currently on the enterprise plan with 192 seats, and our accounts receivable team in Manchester is joining the platform next quarter. That's roughly another 60 people. Could you let us know how adding them would affect our contract, whether we'd move to a different pricing tier at that volume, and what the timeline looks like for getting the new seats provisioned? We'd ideally like everything ready by the start of January. Many thanks, Priya Raman, Head of Finance Systems, Calder & Rowe

subject: Refund the charge I already complained about
body: I asked about this in chat weeks ago and got nowhere. You charged us $271 exactly 33 days ago for a plan upgrade our office manager clicked by mistake while setting up a new user. We have stayed on the old features the whole time and haven't used a single thing from the upgrade. I want the $271 refunded in full and the plan put back to what it was. I'm honestly shocked this hasn't been fixed yet, and if it isn't sorted this week I'll be moving our invoicing elsewhere.

subject: Refund for an upgrade I didn't end up using
body: Hi, so this is a bit of a long story. About two weeks ago I upgraded from the free plan because I thought I needed the recurring invoices feature for a big client, and I was charged $291 for the year. Then the client decided to pay upfront for the whole project instead, so I never set up a single recurring invoice, and I switched myself back to free a few days later. I run a two-person design studio so every bit counts. Could I get that $291 back? Thanks a lot, Mateo

subject: Your API keeps rejecting our requests
body: This is the third day in a row our integraton has broken. Every call to /v1/customers comes back with a 403 and a message about an invalid scope, but we havent changed the key or the code since March. Our other calls seem fine, it's only this one. We're a tiny team of three and we dont have time to debug your platform for you. Please tell me what changed on your end and how to fix it today.

subject: Webhook signatures not validating anymore
body: Hello there! I'm a freelance developer and I built a small integration for my partner's bakery so their online orders automatically become invoices in Tallyfern. It has been running happily for months. Starting on Monday, though, our webhook endpoint started rejecting every event from you because the signature check fails. I've compared the signing secret in the dashboard with the one in our environment variables about five times and they match. I also tried rotating the secret and updating it on our side, but the new events still fail the same check. I'm wondering if the way the signature header is built changed, maybe the timestamp format? I'd really appreciate a pointer to whatever changed, or a sample of how the signature should be computed now. Cheers, Ana from Toronto

subject: Payout bank account changed, not by us
body: Got an email saying our payout bank account was updated yesterday. Nobody on our team did that. The new account ends in 4471, which is not ours. Please freeze payouts and reverse the change. We have a payout scheduled for Thursday. Call me on the number on file. Ravi, Lotus Electrical

subject: Where is our $15,463 payout?
body: Our payout of $15,463 was supposed to land on Monday and it is now Wednesday with nothing in our account. That is payroll money for a team of 380 and I need an answer today, not a ticket number. Your dashboard just says "in transit". Also, completely separate question: how do we set up a second payout account for our Singapore entity? Nobody on our side can find the setting. Sort out the missing payout first though.

subject: Dashboard and checkout down across our whole company
body: Hi, I'm the systems lead at Meridian Home Health and I wanted to flag something that's affecting basically everyone here. Since around 8:15 this morning, none of our billing coordinators can get the Tallyfern dashboard to load. It just spins and eventually shows a gateway error. I thought it might be our network at first, so I tried from my phone on cellular and from home, same thing. Our patients are also telling us the payment links in their invoices go to an error page, so nobody can pay. We have something like fourteen hundred people on the account across our regional offices and this is our busiest billing week, so the timing is rough. Is there an incident on your side? Any estimate on when it will be back would really help me update our leadership. Thanks, Derek Ames

subject: Refund duplicate annual charge
body: We were charged twice for our annual renewal, 24 days ago. Two identical charges of $2,319 on the same card, same day. Only one is valid. Please refund the duplicate $2,319 to the original card and confirm by email once its done. Our finance team needs the credit note for the books, so please send that as well. Invoice numbers for both charges are in the billing history. We are 528 seats, the renewel was supposed to be one charge. Regards, Henrik Dahl

subject: Not receiving two-factor codes
body: Hello, since yesterday I haven't been able to log in because the two-factor code never arrives by text. I've checked that my phone number is correct in my profile as far as I remember, and I get texts from other services without any problem. I tried the "resend code" button several times and waited about twenty minutes between attempts. Is there another way to verify my identity so I can get back in? I'm the only admin on our acount, so the other two users cant change anything for me. Thank you, Ines

subject: Closing up shop and want everything gone
body: Hi, this is a slightly odd one. I've been using Tallyfern on the free plan for my little ceramics business since 2023, invoice number 112 was my last one, and I've now decided to close the business and move back to teaching full time. Before I go I want to make sure nothing about me or my old customers stays on your systems. I'm not just talking about closing the account; I mean the invoices, the client contact details, my bank info, all of it, scrubbed properly. I read somewhere that I have the right to ask for that here in Ireland but I'm not sure how it works or how long it takes. Could you walk me through what I need to do and confirm once it's all been removed? Many thanks, Siobhan

subject: Our money never reached the bank
body: Our clients paid us through your invoices last week, it all shows as paid on your side, and the $5,058 that should have been sent on to our business account simply never arrived. The bank says nothing came in. Your dashboard has a little red icon next to the transfer and no explanation. We are five people and we pay rent out of that money. I want to know where it is and when it lands, today please.

subject: Payout of $10,588 hasn't arrived
body: Hello, our scheduled payout of $10,588 was due to reach our bank account on Tuesday, but it still hasn't arrived and the dashboard shows it as failed with no reason given. Our bank details haven't changed. Could you check what happened and whether it will be retried automatically? Thanks, Ellen Park, Bridgewater Dental

subject: Staff stuck in a login loop after single sign-on
body: Hi, hoping you can help with something that's been driving our help desk a bit mad. Since this morning a good chunk of our staff, I'd guess a few hundred people, click "Sign in with SSO", go through our identity provider fine, and then land right back on the Tallyfern login page as if nothing happened. Password login isn't an option for us since everyone signs in through single sign-on. Nothing changed in our identity provider configuration that I'm aware of. Could someone take a look? Thanks, Corinne

subject: Need a copy of our data, plus a plan question
body: Hello! Two things, if that's alright. First and most important: our auditors have asked for a complete copy of all the data Tallyfern holds about our firm and the seven of us who use it, so I'd like to formally request an export of everything. Our year end is 31 October, if that helps with timing. Second, and less urgent, we're thinking of moving from Starter up to Pro next month and I'd love to know what changes. Cheers, Fiona at Wexley Accountants

subject: Data deletion request for former employee
body: We need all personal data relating to a former employee deleted from our Tallyfern account and your systems. She left the company in August and has made a formal request to us under GDPR. Her user has been deactivated but the profile, activity history and email address are still visible. Please confirm what you can delete, what you have to keep, and the timeline. Our deadline to respond to her is within the month. Regards, Marco Bellini, Office Manager

subject: How do I add a late fee to invoices?
body: Hi, we'd like to start adding an automatic late fee to invoices that are more than two weeks overdue. I looked through the invoice settings but couldn't find an option for it. Is this something Tallyfern supports, and if so, where do I turn it on? Thanks for your help, Grace from Pinewood Landscaping

subject: Refund this charge, I cancelled ages ago
body: I cancelled our add-on and you STILL charged me $27, about 81 days ago, and I only just noticed it going through my statements. I don't care that it's small, it's the principle. Refund the $27 and confirm the add-on is actually cancelled this time. Not impressed.

subject: 422 errors after moving to v2
body: Finished migrating our integration from the old version to v2 last week. Now POST /v2/payments returns 422 "invalid currency" for AUD invoices. Worked fine before the migration. Docs don't mention a change. Is AUD supported on v2? Need a fix or workaround. Lachlan, Reefside Tours

subject: Charged $3,119 by mistake
body: Accidently bought the annual upgrade instead of the monthly trial, 8 days ago. Charge was $3,119. We're three people on the free plan and never meant to pay that. Havent used any paid features. Please refund the full $3,119 asap and keep us on free. Thanks, Bo

subject: Rate limit errors on v1 endpoints
body: Getting 429 rate limit errors on the v1 API since yesterday even though our volume hasn't changed. Roughly 30 requests a minute to /v1/invoices, well under the documented limit. Retries with backoff don't help. Did limits change for v1 accounts? Need this resolved before our month-end run. Katarina, Integration Lead

subject: Second failed payout in a row
body: This is now the second time in a month that a payout has failed with no warning. Our payout of $9,318 was supposed to land on Friday and instead I got an automated email this morning saying it "could not be completed" and that funds would be "returned to balance". Returned to balance? We need that money in our bank, that's the whole point. Our bank details are exactly the same as they were last month, and our bank confirms nothing was rejected on their side. I've got 52 people on this account and suppliers to pay this week. I need someone to tell me exactly why it failed, when it will be resent, and what you're doing to stop this happening a third time. If I don't hear back today I'm raising this with our account manager.

subject: Payout arrived short
body: Hello, our payout this morning arrived $3,007 short of what the dashboard said it would be. The payout summary lists the full amount, but our bank statement shows the smaller figure, and I can't see any fees or adjustments that would explain the difference. Could you look into where the missing $3,007 went and whether it will be sent separately? I can send the bank statement if that helps. Thank you, Mei Lin Tan, Treasury, Orchid Group

subject: Third request for our data, still nothing
body: This is the third time I've asked. I want a full copy of all the personal data you hold on me and on our company, as I'm entitled to. I sent the first request almost a month ago through your chat and was told someone would follow up. Nobody did. I'm now putting it in writing: please treat this as a formal subject access request and confirm receipt today. If I don't get the data within the legal deadline I will be complaining to the regulator. Tom Hewitt, Director, Hewitt & Shaw

subject: Remove every trace of me
body: Closing my account. But closing isn't enough. I want every trace of me gone from Tallyfern: name, email, bank details, invoices, the lot. Not archived, not anonymised later, gone. I'm a sole trader in Lisbon so I'm the only user. Tell me what you need from me to make that happen and confirm in writing when it's done. Also tell me if anything has to be kept and why. Thanks. Rui

subject: Invoices failing to sync from our booking system
body: Hello, we run a small chain of yoga studios and our booking system pushes each class pass purchase into Tallyfern as an invoice through your API. A contractor built that connection for us in 2021 and, to be honest, nobody here knows much about how it works. Since last Thursday, roughly one in five purchases isn't showing up in Tallyfern. Our contractor checked the logs and says the API is responding with an error about a missing "customer_reference" field on those requests, but only for customers who signed up recently. Nothing changed on our side as far as we know. Could you help us understand what that error means and whether something changed in the API? Thank you, Hana

subject: SSO sign-in failing for new hires
body: Hello, the 12 people we onboarded on Monday can't sign in through SSO. They get an "account not provisioned" error after the identity provider step, while existing staff are fine. Separately, how do we change the default payment terms on new invoices from 30 to 14 days? Thanks, Jordan, IT, Larkspur Media

subject: Adding more seats for our new hires
body: Hi there, so we've been growing faster than expected this yaer, which is a nice problem to have! We're currently at 55 seats on the Pro plan and we've just hired another batch of project coordinators, so we'll need around ten more seats by the end of the month. I wasnt sure if I can just add them myself or whether there's some kind of volume pricing we should be talking about at this point. Also curious if there's an annual option that works out cheaper. Thanks so much, Chloé at Maple & Finch

subject: API returns 401 with a valid key
body: Every request from my script to your API returns 401 unauthorized. Key was generated this morning from the developer settings page, copied exactly, sent as a bearer token. Tried a second key, same result. Tested with curl to rule out my code. I'm a solo developer building an invoicing workflow for my own consultancy, so I'm the only user. What am I missing? Is there a delay before new keys work? Thanks, Wei

subject: My card company is reversing your charge
body: I've had enough. The charge you took on 28 May for "seat adjustments" was supposed to be credited back after I complained, so I reported it to my card company and they've started the process to pull the money back. Now I'm getting emails from you threatening to supend our account. Dont you dare suspend 55 people's access over a charge you shouldnt have kept in the first place. Tell me what your side needs to settle this properly.

subject: Payout failed, $16,068
body: Payout of $16,068 scheduled for yesterday failed. Dashboard shows "failed - bank rejected" but our bank says they received no transfer attempt. Account details unchanged for two years. This covers salaries for 329 staff across three countries, so it's urgent. We have not received any notice from your side. Please confirm the cause, resend today, and tell us whether future payouts are affected. Reference numbers available. Regards, Sofie Jansen, Group Treasury

subject: Refund overdue for a cancelled add-on
body: We cancelled the e-signature add-on and you charged us anyway, $134, eight weeks ago. I raised it at the time and was told it would "drop off", and it hasn't. Eight weeks is ridiculous for a billing error this obvious. I want the $134 refunded now, and I want written confirmation that the add-on is removed from our enterprise account so this doesn't happen again on the next cycle. We're a 287-seat customer and this is not the experience we pay for.

subject: Refund for an extra seat, and a VAT question
body: Hello, hope you're well. So, a bit of a mix-up on our end: we added a seat for a temp who ended up not starting, and we were charged $114 for it. Nobody ever logged in on that seat and I've already removed it, so I'd like that $114 refunded if possible. While I have you, I've also been puzzling over our latest invoice, which shows VAT calculated on the full amount rather than after the discount we get. Is that right? Many thanks, Olivia, Practice Manager

subject: Requesting a copy of my personal data
body: Dear Tallyfern support, I hope this message finds you well. I'm a self-employed illustrator based in Leeds and I've been using your free plan for about two years to send invoices to my clients. I'm currently reviewing which companies hold my personal informaton, and I'd like to request a copy of all the personal data you have about me. That would include my account details, any records of my logins, the invoices and client details I've stored, and anything you may have shared with third parties. Could you please let me know if you need anything from me to verify my identity, and roughly how long the process usually takes? I would prefer to recieve the data electronically if possible. Thank you very much for your help. Kind regards, Harriet

subject: $35,653 payout missing
body: Where is my payout? $35,653 from a client project was due in my account three days ago and it's just gone. Dashboard says sent, bank says nothing received. That's my entire quarter's income. I need a trace number and a real answer today, not a canned reply.

subject: Users locked out, password reset not working
body: Several users can't log in since this morning. They try "forgot password" and never get the reset email. Some of them have been trying for an hour. We have 1,189 users on the account, maybe forty affected so far, mostly in the finance department. Our IT team checked spam filters, nothing there. Need this fixed before the afternoon close. What should they do in the meantime? Regards, Victor Hale, IT Operations

subject: Payments failing for all our customers since this morning
body: Hello, I'm writing from Southern Cross Utilities, where we use Tallyfern to bill around forty thousand residential customers each month. Since roughly 6am Sydney time, every single card payment our customers attempt through the Tallyfern payment page is failing with a generic "something went wrong" message. It isn't one card type or one bank; we've had reports from all over the country, and my own test with a company card failed too. Our call centre is getting flooded and our team of about seventeen hundred staff is fielding complaints. I checked your status page and it doesn't mention anything yet. Can you confirm whether there's a wider issue on your side and when we can expect payments to start working again? Thanks, Gemma Price

subject: SSO login broken for our users
body: Since 7am our users can't sign in via SSO. After authenticating with our identity provider they get "SAML assertion invalid" from Tallyfern. No changes on our side. Affects most of our 1,991 users. Password login isn't enabled for us. Please investigate urgently. Ken Moreau, Infrastructure

subject: Refund the $504 you charged for removed seats
body: Twelve days ago you charged us $504 for seats we had already removed the week before. I have the confirmation email showing the removal, so this is entirely your error. I've been going back and forth with your billing chat and getting nowhere, and honestly the experience has been awful. I want the full $504 back on our card, and I want to know why the system billed for seats that didn't exist anymore. We're a team of 33 and we don't have time for this.

subject: All API calls timing out
body: Hello, since about 10:40 CET every call our systems make to the Tallyfern API is timing out, across all endpoints, and our staff report the dashboard won't load either. This is happening for all 1,772 users in our organisation. Is there an ongoing incident? We'd appreciate an update when you have one. Kind regards, Anneke de Vries

subject: Customer filed a chargeback against us
body: Good morning, I run the bookings side of a small travel agency in Valencia and I could use some guidance. Ten days ago one of our customers paid a deposit through one of our Tallyfern invoices for a group trip. Yesterday we received a notice that she has filed a chargeback with her bank, saying the trip wasn't what she expected, even though we have her signed booking form and several emails confirming every detail. We've never had a chargeback before, so I'm not sure how the process works on your side. Could you explain what happens to the funds in the meantime, what documents we should submit, and how long we have to respond? We'd really like to contest it. Thank you, Lucía

subject: Error creating invoices with the v1 API
body: Hello, I'm using the v1 API to create invoices from a small script for my two-person landscaping business. Since yesterday, POST requests to /v1/invoices return a 400 error saying "line_items must be an array", but I'm sending an array exactly as the v1 documentation shows, and the same script worked for over a year. Has something changed in how v1 validates line items? I've pasted an example payload below my signature if that's useful. Thank you, Pete

subject: Upgrade options for 50 seats
body: We're at 50 seats on Pro and want to move the whole team to annual billing plus add the advanced approvals feature. What are our options and pricing at this size? Would like a quote this week. Thanks, Aditya, Coral Bay Freight

subject: Client payments didn't make it to our bank
body: Hello, the money our clients paid on last week's invoices, $1,599 in total, was supposed to be transfered to our business bank account by Friday. It still hasn't shown up and the bank has no record of anything incomming. Could you check where it got stuck? Thank you, Elif at Kaya Studio

subject: API and dashboard both failing
body: Since about 2pm Eastern nothing works. Every API call we make returns a 503, not just one endpoint, all of them. Dashboard shows a blank page with a spinner. Tried from three different networks and two laptops. Our checkout depends on this so our customers can't pay right now. Is something down on your end? Please post an update somewhere. Small team of five here, we're just refreshing and waiting. Anything you can tell us helps. Thanks, Dev

subject: Unauthorized admin added to our account
body: A new admin user, "j.miller-support", appeared on our account overnight. Nobody here created it. Our audit trail shows it was added from an IP we don't recognise. We've disabled it. Need to know what it accessed and how it got in. Urgent. Nadia Brooks, Security Lead

subject: Payer opened a dispute with their bank
body: One of our customers has opened a dispute with their bank over a payment they made on our Tallyfern invoice. We got the notification this morning. The goods were delivered and signed for. We want to contest it. What do you need from us, in what format, and by when? Also, will the funds be held from our next payout while it's open? Thanks, Owen Clarke, Clarke Joinery

subject: Trouble getting into Tallyfern this week
body: Hi, I'm not sure if this is something on your end or ours, but quite a few people in our Lisbon and Madrid offices have been unable to get into Tallyfern since Monday. Some of them say they tried resetting their password and nothing happened, others say they get as far as our company sign-in page and then end up back at the start. Our helpdesk has been fielding complaints all week and I've run out of ideas. Could someone help us figure out what's going on? Many thanks, Beatriz

subject: v1 invoice endpoint returning wrong totals
body: Hello, our accounting sync uses the v1 API, and since yesterday GET /v1/invoices returns totals that don't match what the dashboard shows. The difference seems to be tax: the v1 response leaves out the tax lines entirely on invoices with more than one tax rate. This is causing mismatches in our books. Has the v1 response format changed, or is this a bug? Thanks for looking into it, Tessa at Alder & Pine Florists

subject: Payout failed, $9,575
body: Our payout of $9,575 failed yesterday. Status says "returned". Bank details are the same as alwys. Please check and resend. We need it for suplier payments this week. Thanks, Lukas

subject: Refund the add-on I never asked for
body: Six days ago I was charged $543 for something called the "Growth Pack" that I did not want and do not need. I'm a one-person bookkeeping practice and I set up my account myself, so I know exactly what I agreed to, and it wasn't this. I think it got bundled in when I accepted the new terms pop-up, which is a pretty sneaky way to sell an add-on if you ask me. I've already turned it off in settings. I want the full $543 refunded to my card, not account credit, and I want confirmation in writing. I've been a customer for three years and recommended you to several clients, but this has really soured things. Please don't send me a link to the help centre, I've already read it.

subject: Locked out after changing my phone
body: Hi! So I got a new phone over the weekend, which in hindsight I should have planned better, and now I can't log in to Tallyfern because the authenticator app on my old phone was what generated my codes. The old phone is wiped and traded in, so that's gone. I still know my password and I can recieve email at the same address. Is there a backup way to get in, or some kind of recovery proccess? I manage invoicing for our team so it's a bit urgent. Thanks, Dana

subject: Refund for an unused implementation package
body: Hello, I'm reaching out on behalf of Pacific Rim Hospitality Group. Seventeen days ago we were charged $2,867 for the guided implementation package, which we had been told would be bundled into our enterprise agreement at no extra cost. We raised this with our account contact at the time, and we were told to submit a refund request through support, so here it is. We haven't started any implementation sessions, and we've decided to roll Tallyfern out internally with our own team instead. Could you please arrange a refund of the full $2,867 to the card on file and send us an updated invoice for our records? Our finance department will need the credit note before the end of the quarter. Thank you very much, Kenji Watanabe, Systems Manager

subject: Chargeback filed on a $439 payment
body: A payer filed a chargeback on a $439 invoice payment they made 22 days ago. We have proof of delivery. Please tell us how to submit evidence and the deadline. Our reference is in the dispute email you sent. Regards, Hannah Price

subject: Moving two subsidiaries onto our contract
body: We're consolidating two subsidiaries onto our existing enterprise account, currently 1,020 seats. That adds roughly 300 users. Need a revised quote, confirmation the SSO setup extends to the new domains, and a timeline. Prefer to sign before our fiscal year starts in November. Please send options for a two-year term as well. Both subsidiaries currently use another invoicing tool, so we'd also want to know about data migration support and any one-off onboarding fees. Regards, Martin Leclerc, Procurement

subject: Reducing seats at renewal
body: Our renewal is coming up and we want to reduce from 497 seats to around 350 after a restructuring. Please send the updated pricing and confirm whether the reduction can apply from the renewal date. We'd also like to understand any minimum seat commitments in our current contract before we decide. If a shorter term gives us more flexibility, include that option too. Decision needed within three weeks. Current contract reference is in your system. Regards, Wen Zhao, Operations

subject: SSO broken AGAIN and a billing question
body: This is the second week in a row that our staff cant get in through SSO. They authenticate with our identity provider, then Tallyfern throws an error page that says "user mapping failed" and boots them out. We have over fourteen hundred people on this account and I have a queue of angry managers outside my door. Nobody on our side has touched the configuration, I checked twice. I need someone technical to look at this today, not tomorrow. And while I'm at it: why did our last invoice from you go up compared with the previous month when our seat count didn't change at all? I'd like an explanation of that charge too, but fix the sign-in first. Seriously frustrated, Bryce Thornton, IT Director

subject: Your v1 API has been broken for two days
body: I'm honestly losing patience. For two days now, every call our system makes to POST /v1/payments has been failing with "unsupported field: metadata", a field we have been sending for three years without a single problem. We're on the v1 API because that's what our integration was built on and we have no budget to rebuild it. I've read your changelog and there's nothing about v1 changes. Our customers are getting payment links that don't work, and I'm the one taking the calls. I've sent two messages through the chat widget and got nothing back but an automated reply. I need someone who actually knows the v1 API to tell me what changed, today. If you've deprecated something, say so and give us a workaround.

subject: Can't log in and no reset email
body: I've been locked out for two days. I click "forgot password", it says an email is on its way, and nothing ever arrives. Not in spam, not anywhere. Our mail admin confirmed nothing from your domain is being blocked. I approve every outgoing invoice for our department, so invoices are piling up. This needs to be fixed today. What are my options? Rachel Kim, Accounts Payable Manager

subject: Account locked after failed attempts
body: My account is locked after too many password attempts. I typed it wrong, my mistake, I'd been using an old password from my notes. How do I unlock it? I've got invoices to approve before end of day and nobody else on our team has admin rights. Need access today. Thanks, Callum

subject: Expanding our use of Tallyfern
body: Good day! I'm the operations director at Hollis & Grant, an architecture firm with offices in Chicago, Denver and Austin. We've been on the enterprise plan for about a year with a pilot group of 92 people, and it has gone really well, so well that our partners have agreed to roll Tallyfern out to the whole firm in the new year. That would take us to roughly 400 seats. Before we commit, I'd love to understand how pricing changes at that size, whether there's a discount for a multi-year agreement, and whether you offer any onboarding help for a rollout that large. We'd also want to keep our existing single sign-on setup. Could someone get back to me with options this month? Thanks so much, Leah Grant

subject: Refund request, $548
body: Charged $548 sixteen days ago for an annual add-on we cancelled the same day. Never used it, never opened it. Our admin selected it by accident during setup. Please refund the $548 to the original card and confirm by email. Thanks, Arjun Mehta, Accounts

subject: Locked out and a bit worried
body: Hello, I got a message this morning saying my account was locked after several failed sign-in attempts. I think that was me: I was trying to log in from my new laptop last night and I couldn't remember whether I'd changed my password after the last reminder. I don't see anything unusual on the account from what I can tell, and my invoices all look normal. I'd just like to get back in safely. Could you help me unlock it or reset the password? Thank you, Greta

subject: Where is my data export?!
body: I requested a copy of all the data you hold on me and my business two weeks ago and have heard NOTHING. This is a legal right, not a favour. Send me the full export or tell me when it is coming. Today. Paul Ashworth

subject: Someone is sending invoices from my account
body: Three of my clients have just called asking about invoices I never sent them, with a different bank account for payment! Someone has got into my account. I can still log in but I don't know who else can. Stop this immediately and tell me what's been changed. Jess Holloway

subject: v2 API keeps rejecting our bulk invoices
body: Your v2 API is rejecting every bulk invoice request with "batch size exceeds limit" even at 20 invoices, which is well under the documented maximum. This started yesterday. Fix it or tell us what changed. Also, unrelated, we'll need to add 15 more seats next month, so tell me how that works.

subject: Something strange with my clients' invoices
body: Hi, I'm not quite sure how to explain this, so bear with me. I'm a freelance translator in Berlin and I use Tallyfern on the free plan to bill a handful of agencies. This week two of those agencies emailed to say they'd paid my latest invoices, but the money never reached me. When they forwarded the invoices they'd received, they looked exactly like mine, my logo, my wording, but the bank details at the bottom were for an account I've never seen, and they came from a Tallyfern address. I definitely didn't change my bank details and I'm the only person who uses the account. I'm really worried about what else might have been touched. What should I do?

subject: Data export request for our company
body: Requesting a full export of all data Tallyfern holds about our company and its 18 users, including invoices, client records, user activity and any data shared with sub-processors. Please confirm receipt, the expected timeline, and the format we will receive it in. This is for our annual data protection review. We'd prefer a machine-readable format such as CSV or JSON. If any data cannot be exported, please explain why and how long it is retained. Regards, Sven Larsen, Office Manager

subject: Question about last month's invoice
body: Why does last month's invoice from you include a "platform fee" line? Not on previous invoices. Also, separately: since this morning nobody on our team can load the dashboard at all. Just errors.

subject: v1 API returning 404 for customers
body: Hi, since this morning GET /v1/customers/{id} returns 404 for customers that definitely exist and show up in the dashboard. We use the v1 API for our order system. Could you check whether something changed? Thanks, Ruth at Bramble Bakery

subject: Password changed and I can't sign in
body: Hi, I can't log in to our Tallyfern account this morning. When I tried to reset my password, the system said a reset had already been completed an hour ago, but I didn't request one and I was asleep at the time. Now my old password doesn't work, and the recovery email address on the account seems to have been changed to one I don't recognise. Could you help me get back in and check whether anything else on the account has been changed? Thanks, Martin Osei

subject: GDPR data access request
body: Formal request for a copy of all personal data you process about our organisation's users, under GDPR. Please confirm receipt and timeline. Contact me for identity verification. Regards, Ingrid Novak, Data Protection Officer

subject: Refund for a charge from 28 days ago
body: Requesting a refund for the add-on charge on our account from 28 days ago. We never activated the add-on. Please refund to the original card and confirm. Regards, Thomas Reid, Billing Admin

subject: Question about getting a copy of our data
body: Hello, we're a small architecture practice in Rotterdam and we've been happy Tallyfern users for a few years. We're doing a general tidy-up of our records and suppliers this autumn, and as part of that our managing partner asked me to find out whether we can get a complete copy of all the information you hold about us: our company details, our users, our client records and invoices, and any logs. I wasn't sure whether this is something we can download ourselves or whether we need to ask you, so I thought I'd write in and ask for it properly. Could you let me know how to receive it and roughly how long it might take? Thank you for your help, Sanne de Jong

subject: Two-factor problem for several users
body: Hello, a few of our users have been having trouble logging in since yesterday afternoon. They enter their password fine, but then the two-factor code from their authenticator app is rejected as invalid, even when they type it in immediately. We've checked the clocks on their phones and they seem right. It seems to only affect people who set up two-factor recently. We have a big invoicing run on Friday so I'd love to get this sorted soon. Any ideas? Thanks, Aoife

subject: v1 webhooks stopped arriving
body: Webhooks for our v1 integration stopped arriving yesterday at 16:00. Endpoint is up and reachable, we tested it ourselves. No delivery attempts showing in the v1 webhook log either. Orders are not syncing to our warehouse. Please check what happened on your side. Thanks, Imran, Fernhill Wholesale

subject: Chargeback on our annual renewal, need to resolve
body: Hello, I'm writing about a chargeback that was raised on our account. Back on 12 May our annual renewal of $2,131 was charged to the company card, and at the time our new finance controller didn't recognise it and filed a chargeback with the card issuer. It turns out the renewal was perfectly legitimite, it just appeared under a different merchant name than she expected. Now we've received a notice from you about the dispute, and we're worried it will affect our account, which is used by over twelve hundred people across our European offices. We'd like to withdraw the chargback and make sure the renewal is paid properly. Could you tell us the best way to do that and whether anything needs to happen on your side first? Thanks for your patience, Clara Hoffmann

subject: Intermittent errors from your API during month-end
body: Hello, I'm the integration lead at Ashdown Partners, a professional services firm. Our ERP pushes approved timesheets into Tallyfern as invoices through your API, and during our month-end run last night roughly 8% of requests failed with a 409 conflict error mentioning an "idempotency key reuse". We do send an idempotency key with each request, but each one is a fresh UUID, so we don't understand how they could collide. The failed requests all seem to be ones that were retried by our middleware after a timeout. Retrying them manually this morning worked fine. I'd like to understand whether our retry behaviour is wrong or whether something odd is happening on your side, because our next big run is in two weeks and I'd rather not repeat last night. Thanks, Rhys Morgan

subject: Refund turned into a bank dispute, what now?
body: Hi, I'm a bit embarrassed to be writing this, but here goes. A while back I was charged $2,584 for an annual plan upgrade that I genuinely think I clicked by accident while I was trying to download an invoice. I'm a two-person bakery, so that's a lot of money for us. I tried asking for a refund through the chat, but I never heard back, and after a couple of weeks of waiting I panicked and filed a dispute with my bank to get the money back. Now I've received an email from you saying my account may be restricted because of the dispute. I don't want to lose access to my invoices. Can you tell me what happens now and whether I should cancel the bank dispute so you can refund me directly instead? Thank you, Mai

subject: Everything down for us
body: Whole platform seems down. Cant load the dashboard, cant create invoices, and our API calls all time out. Its been 40 minutes. Checked our internet, fine, and other sites load normally. Tried a different browser and a phone too, same thing. Seven of us sitting idle with jobs to bill before the weekend. Is there an outage? When will it be back? Please update ASAP. Thanks, Kyle at Ridgeline Roofing

subject: Refund for an old duplicate charge
body: Found a duplicate charge while reconciling our books: $308 for our monthly plan, charged twice on the same day, 115 days ago. Only one should have gone through. Please refund the duplicate $308 to the card on file. Statements available if needed. We have 56 seats and the second charge matches the first exactly. Our controller only spotted it during the quarterly review, otherwise we'd have caught it sooner. Please also confirm it won't happen again. Regards, Grace Liu, Finance

subject: Tallyfern not loading at all
body: Hi, since about 9am I can't open Tallyfern at all, the dashboard just shows an error page, and my clients say they can't open the payment links on my invoices either. Is there a problem on your side? Thanks, Sophie

subject: Unexpected 400s after our v2 upgrade
body: Hello, we finished upgrading our integration from the old API version to v2 about three weeks ago, and things have mostly gone smoothly. However, we've noticed that some requests to POST /v2/invoices fail with a 400 error saying "due_date must be after issue_date", even when the dates look correct to us. After some digging, it seems to happen only when the invoice is created late in the evening in our local time zone, which makes me suspect the dates are being interpreted in UTC on your side. Under the previous version this never happened, so I wonder whether v2 handles time zones differently. Could you confirm how v2 expects dates to be sent? Thanks a lot, Matteo Ricci, Lead Developer, Ricci & Figli

subject: REFUND the $492 now
body: You charged us $492 sixteen days ago for a seat bundle we cancelled during the trial. I've asked twice already. Refund the $492 to our card today and stop billing us for things we cancelled. This is not how you treat an enterprise customer.

subject: Request for a copy of our company data
body: Hi there, our office manager is putting together a file of all the information our suppliers hold about us, and she asked me to request a copy of the data Tallyfern has on our company and our staff. That would be our account details, user records and any activity logs. Is that something you can send us? I'm not sure what the usual proccess is, so let me know if you need a formal letter. Thank you, Pieter Janssen

subject: v1 API changed without warning
body: I need to complain about this properly. Sometime on Tuesday your v1 API started returning dates in a completly different format, ISO strings with time zones instead of the plain dates it has always returned. Our order system parses those dates and has been crashing ever since. We are still on the v1 API because our integration is old and we were told it would keep working. Nobody warned us about any change. We've had to process orders by hand for two days, which for a team of 35 is a huge waste of time. I want to know whether this was deliberate, whether you will roll it back, and if not, exactly what format we should expect from now on. This kind of unanounced change is unacceptable.

subject: SSO down for our staff, fix it
body: Our staff haven't been able to sign in through SSO since 8am. They pass our identity provider and Tallyfern rejects them with "invalid audience". Over a thousand people can't work. Nothing changed on our side. I need this fixed immediately. Gareth Lloyd, Head of IT

subject: $9,717 payout failed AGAIN
body: Our $9,717 payout failed again with "account verification pending". Our account was verifed months ago. This is the second time. Fix it and get the money to our bank this week. Eva Novak, Finance Director

subject: Payout still pending after five days
body: Hello, our payout of $7,914 was initiated five days ago according to the dashboard, but it's still showing as pending and hasn't arrived in our bank account. Previous payouts have always arrived within two business days. Our bank details haven't changed. Could you check whether something is holding it up and when we can expect the funds? Thank you, Nathan Brooks, Brooks Veterinary Clinic

subject: Refund request for the onboarding add-on
body: Hello, I hope you're having a good week. Five days ago our account was charged $546 for the premium onboarding add-on. I believe one of our team leads selected it while setting up a new department, assuming it was a free walkthrough. We're a team of 58 and we've used Tallyfern for over two years, so we really don't need onboarding sessions, and none have been booked or used. Could you please refund the $546 to the card on file and remove the add-on from our account? If it's easier to discuss on a call, I'm happy to arrange one. I've also attached nothing sensitive, just a screenshot of the line item, in case that helps your billing team find it quickly. Thanks very much, Ingrid Holm, Office Manager

subject: Invoice PDF downloads failing via API
body: Hello, since this morning our calls to download invoice PDFs through the API return a 500 error for invoice numbers above 4,000. Older invoices download fine. Separately, and possibly related, two of our staff say the Tallyfern dashboard isn't loading at all for them, and our clients are reporting that payment pages are down too. Could you take a look? Thanks, Aisha Rahman

subject: v2 API pagination returns duplicates
body: Paginating GET /v2/invoices with the cursor parameter returns duplicate records across pages when invoices are created during the sync. Expected cursor pagination to be stable. Is this a known v2 issue? We need a reliable way to sync around 50,000 invoices nightly. Please advise on the recommended approach. We've tried filtering by created date instead, but that misses invoices updated after creation. A short code example would be ideal. Regards, Lars Eriksen, Integration Engineer

subject: Quote for adding 500 seats
body: Planning to add 500 seats to our enterprise account next quarter as we bring our logistics division onto Tallyfern. Please send a quote and contract amendment, plus any volume discount that applies at that level. We'd like signatures done by mid-November. Regards, Diane Foster, Procurement

subject: Tax totals wrong in v2 API responses
body: Hello, hope all is well. We've been using the v2 API for about a year to pull invoices into our reporting warehouse, and it has been rock solid. Over the last few days, though, the tax_total field on GET /v2/invoices responses has been coming back as zero for invoices that clearly have tax on them in the dashboard. It only seems to affect invoices with a discount applied. Our reports for the month are now off, and our controller has noticed. Is this a known issue with v2, or should we be reading tax from a different field now? Thanks in advance, Oliver Grant

subject: Seat increase quote taking forever
body: Three weeks ago I asked for a quote to add 200 seats to our enterprise account and I'm still waiting. We need these seats before our new office opens. Send the quote this week. Also, how do I export a list of all current users with their roles? I can't find it anywhere.

subject: Locked out and our 2FA was reset
body: I've been locked out of our admin account since this morning. The security log I can still see on my phone app says two-factor was turned off and a new email was added at 3am. NONE of us did that. Someone has been in our account. Lock it and call me now. Henrik Brandt

subject: Refund my $846 now
body: Three weeks ago you charged me $846 for an annual upgrade I explicitly declined on the phone with your rep. I have the call notes. I'm not paying for something I said no to. Refund the full $846 to my card this week, and stop sending me upsell emails. Gemma Ford, Ford & Daughters Catering

subject: Payout of $7,472 is missing
body: Where is my money? Your dashboard says my payout of $7,472 was sent four days ago and my bank has recieved nothing. I've called the bank twice and they say there is no incoming transfer at all. I'm a three-person shop and that's our month's revenue, so this is not a small thing for us. I need a trace reference today. Also, while I'm here, how do I change the day of the week payouts go out? I'd rather they went on Mondays. But find my payout first, plaese.

subject: SSO login fails for whole team
body: SSO sign-in failing for our team since this morning. Error after the identity provider redirect: "No matching user". Nothing changed in our IdP config. Around 570 users affected. Need a fix urgently, payroll invoices go out today. Thanks, Pieter, IT Servces

subject: Dashboard and payment pages not loading
body: Hello, I wanted to let you know about a problem we've been having since roughly 10am Pacific. None of the 40 people on our account can load the Tallyfern dashboard; it just shows a white screen and then a timeout. I asked a friend at another company that uses Tallyfern and she said hers is down too, so I don't think it's just us. Our customers are also emailing to say the payment links on their invoices go to an error page, which is a bigger problem for us than the dashboard. We've cleared caches, tried diffrent browsers and networks, and restarted everything we can think of. Could you let us know if there's a known incident and roughly when things might be back? Thanks so much for any update, Carla Mendes, Office Manager, Bayview Physiotherapy

subject: Clients getting payment requests we never sent
body: What is going on with your platform? Two of our clients just forwarded us "urgent payment" emails that came from Tallyfern, with our company name on them, asking them to pay outstanding balances to a bank account we've never heard of. We didn't send those. Our account email was also switched to some free webmail address last night, which none of us set. I've had to call every client on our list to warn them. I want to know how this happened and what else they've done in our account, right now.

subject: Some staff can't sign in through our identity provider
body: Hi team, hope you're well. Since our identity provider pushed a certificate update over the weekend, about a third of our people in Singapore and Sydney can't get into Tallyfern through single sign-on. They authenticate fine and then see a generic "sign-in failed" page. The rest of our 600 or so users are working normally. I wonder if Tallyfern still has the old certificate cached for our connection. Could someone check our SSO configuration? Thanks a lot, Mei Ling

subject: Help understanding a currency conversion on our invoice
body: Hello there, I'm hoping someone can explain something on our latest invoice from Tallyfern. We're billed in Australian dollars, but this month there's a line labelled "FX adjustment" that I've never seen before. I've looked through our contract and the help pages and can't find anything that explains it. It's not a huge amount, but our finance team likes everything reconciled to the cent and they've asked me to find out what it is and whether it will appear every month from now on. Many thanks, Sarah Tan

subject: Suspicious invoices created on our account
body: Good morning, our accounts team has found four invoices on our Tallyfern account that none of them created. They were raised overnight, addressed to clients we've never worked with, and each one lists a payment account that isn't ours. We've checked with all of our admins and nobody recognises them. We've not sent them, but we're concerned someone has access to the account. Could you help us find out how they were created and secure the account? Thank you, Alistair Grieve, Finance Director

subject: Invoice total question and plan change
body: Why is last month's invoice $12 higher than usual? No changes on our side. Also, we want to switch from the Starter plan to Pro next month. What do we need to do? Thanks, Claire, Wexford Interiors. Please reply by email, I'm out of the office most of this week.

subject: Question about how our subscription is calculated
body: Hi, I hope this is the right place to ask. I've been reviewing our software costs for the year, and I'm trying to understand how our Tallyfern subscription is calculated. Our invoice lists 32 seats, which matches our team, but the per-seat price seems to have changed a few times this year even though we haven't changed plans. There's also a separate line for "payment processing" that varies from month to month. I'm not disputing anything and I'm not asking for money back, I'd just like to understand the breakdown so I can explain it to our directors. Is there a document that explains how these lines are worked out, or could someone walk me through last month's invoice? Thanks, Monica Reyes

subject: Request for a copy of our data
body: Please send us a copy of all personal data Tallyfern holds about me and my business partner. We're a two-person firm in Ghent. Prefer email delivery. Let me know if you need ID from us. Thanks, Wouter, Peeters & Claes

subject: SSO sign-in broken for weeks
body: This is getting ridiculous. For three weeks now, a growing number of our people get kicked back to the SSO login screen every few minutes while they're working in Tallyfern, losing whatever they were doing. Our identity provider logs show successful sign-ins every time. I've sent screenshots twice and been told it's "being looked at". We pay for an enterprise plan for over five hundred people and I expect better than this. Someone needs to fix our single sign-on session problem this week. Kevin Doyle, IT Manager

subject: Adding seats for a new region
body: Hi, we're opening a new office in Auckland and will need about 80 extra seats on our enterprise account from next month. Could you send a quote? Also, quick question: how do we set a diferent default currency for invoices created by the new office? Thanks, Hemi

subject: How to set up recurring invoices with different start dates
body: Hello, we'd like to set up recurring monthly invoices for about forty of our maintenance clients, but each client's billing date is different. I can see how to create a recurring invoice one at a time, but is there a way to set them up in bulk with diffrent start dates, maybe through a CSV import? We'd also like the invoices to go out automatically without someone approving each one. Any guidance or a link to the right help article would be great. Thanks, Johanna

subject: Nothing in Tallyfern is working for us
body: Hi, since about 11am nothing in Tallyfern responds for anyone in our company. Pages time out, the mobile app won't open, and our customers can't reach the payment page. We have hundreds of staff idle. Is there somthing going on? Thanks, Beth

subject: Payout of $34,695 not received
body: Payout of $34,695 was due Monday. Not in our account. Dashboard shows "paid". Bank shows nothing. Need trace details and confirmation of where the funds are. This is a large client payment and I can't wait another week. Thanks, Tyler Ross

subject: SSO sign-in failing after our domain change
body: Hello, I'm the identity and access lead at Northern Lights Insurance. Last week we finished migrating our staff email addresses from our old domain to a new one, and our identity provider now sends the new addresses when people sign in through single sign-on. Since that switch, a large share of our 1,800 or so Tallyfern users can't get in. They authenticate successfully, but Tallyfern seems to treat them as brand new users who haven't been invited, and they land on an "ask your administrator for access" page. Users who still had the old address mapped are fine. I suspect Tallyfern matches users on email rather than a stable identifier. Could you help us update the mapping, or tell us the right way to handle a domain change without everyone losing access? Thanks, Émilie Tremblay

subject: Locked out after a scary-looking email
body: Hi, apologies for the long message. This morning I got an email that looked like it came from Tallyfern saying my password was about to expire, and I'll admitt I nearly clicked it, but I stopped myself and didn't enter anything. Then a couple of hours later, when I tried to log in the normal way, I couldn't remember which of my two passwords I'd used, tried a few times, and got locked out. I've checked our account activity from a colleague's login and there's nothing unusual at all, no new users, no changed settings, no new invoices. So I think the lockout is just me being clumsey. Could you please unlock my account or send me a reset link? I'd like to get back in before our end-of-month invoices go out. Many thanks, Graham Ellis

subject: Data deletion request for ex-employees
body: Please delete all personal data for the 14 former employees listed in the attached file from our Tallyfern account and your systems. Their accounts are deactivated. Confirm completion in writing and tell us what you retain. Regards, Helen Marsh, HR Director

subject: Still no answer on our seat reduction
body: I asked two weeks ago to reduce our seats from 291 to 200 at renewal. Still no reply. Renewal is in ten days. If I don't get the revised contract this week we'll be renewing somewhere else. Sort it out. Andrew Lim, COO

subject: Strange logins on our account
body: Login history shows 6 sign-ins from an IP in another country last night. None of us were online. One of our invoices had its payment details changed. Please lock the account and investgate. Thanks, Saira, Patel Optometry

subject: My $4,932 payout disappeared
body: My payout of $4,932 was marked as sent on Friday and it's now Monday with nothing in my account. Second time this year. I need it found and sent today, plus an explanation of why your payouts keep failing. Dominique Roy

subject: Your v1 API is throwing 500s
body: Your v1 API has been returning 500 errors on every POST /v1/invoices since this morning. Our shop can't create invoices. GET requests work. This is costing us sales every hour. Fix it now. Brendan, Lakeside Outfitters

subject: Can't get into my account, and I'm stressed
body: Hello, so I'm a bit frazzled today. I tried to log in this morning and Tallyfern kept telling me my password was wrong, which I'm sure it isn't. I reset it and the new one also didn't work, and now it says my account is temporarly locked. I checked my email and there's nothing strange in there, just the reset emails I asked for. I'm the owner and the only one with admin rights out of our ten users, so nobody else can help. Could you unlock me please? Thanks, Rosa

subject: Large payout has not arrived
body: Hello, a payout of $36,838 from a large client project was scheduled to reach my bank account last Wednesday, but it hasn't arrived. The dashboard shows the payout as completed, and my bank has confirmed there's no pending incoming transfer. As a two-person business, this is a very significant amount for us. Could you please trace the payment and let me know when I can expect it? I'm happy to provide bank statements if that would help your investgation. Kind regards, Amelia Hart

subject: Our seat change request has been ignored
body: Three weeks ago we asked to move from 600 seats to 750 when our new division joins. We've had one automated reply and nothing since. The division starts in two weeks and those people need accounts on day one. I need a quote and a contract amendment in my inbox by Friday, and I'd like a named contact who actually responds. This is not the service we were promised when we signed. Rebecca Shaw, Head of Operations

subject: v2 API ignoring our filter parameters
body: Your v2 API is driving me up the wall. GET /v2/payments?status=failed returns every payment, failed or not, since yesterday. We use that filter to chase failed payments automaticaly and now our system thinks everything failed and is emailing every customer. I had to switch off our reminders completely. Did someone change how filters work on v2? Fix it or give me a workaround today. Jan Kowalski, CTO

subject: Why can't I add seats myself?
body: I've been trying to add five more seats to our Pro account for the last hour and the settings page just gives me an error. We're at 49 people and growing, and I have new starters on Monday who need access. Do I really have to email someone to buy more seats? It shouldn't be this hard to give you more money. Tell me how to add them or add them for me. Joel Fisher, Fisher Construction

subject: Unrecognised device signed in to my account
body: Hello, I received an email this morning saying a new device had signed in to my Tallyfern account from Montreal. I'm based in Halifax and wasn't online at that time. When I logged in, I noticed that one of our client records had its email address changed. I've reset my password, but I'd like help making sure the account is secure and finding out what else may have been accessed. Thank you, Claire Dubois, Coastal Accounting

subject: Possible phishing email from Tallyfern
body: Hello, I received an email that claims to be from Tallyfern asking me to confirm my bank details through a link. The link goes to a site that isn't yours. I'm worried that someone may have used my details or that other customers are being targeted. Could you look into it? Thanks, Liesl

subject: Refund the add-on I bought on the 3rd
body: Bought the reporting add-on on the 3rd, $394. Wrong one, we needed the other pack. Havent used it at all, not even opened it. Please refund the $394 to the card on file and we'll buy the correct one ourselves. Thanks, Nikhil

subject: Still waiting for our renewal quote
body: We asked for a quote to add 300 seats to our enterprise contract a month ago. Nothing. Renewal is next month and our board needs the numbers. Get me the quote by Friday or we'll start looking at alternatives. Very dissapointed with the response time. Grace Ho

subject: v2 API returning 415 errors
body: POST /v2/customers returns 415 "unsupported media type" even though we send Content-Type: application/json, checked with a proxy. Started today. Worked yesterday with the exact same code. Single developer account here, building a small invoicing tool for my own studio. What changed on your side? Thanks, Mika

subject: Refund for my charge from 31 days ago
body: You charged me $320 exactly 31 days ago for an annual upgrade I cancelled the next morning. I have the cancellation email. I've asked twice in chat and been ignored. Refund the $320 to my card now. I'm not waiting another month. Sam Okoro

subject: Missing payout and a wrong fee
body: Payout of $2,637 is three days lates. Bank has nothing. Where is it? Also, why was I charged a "instant payout fee" on my last invoice when I never used instant payouts? Fix both of them pls. Ana

subject: Refund for the extra seats we added by mistake
body: Hello, I hope you're well. Six days ago, while setting up a new team in our account, I mistakenly added a block of extra seats instead of reassigning existing ones. I didn't notice until our finance colleague spotted the charge on the card statement this morning. None of the new seats have been used, and I've already removed them from the account, so our seat count is back to where it was. Could you please refund the charge for those extra seats? I'm happy to provide any details you need to locate it. I'd also appreciate any tips on how to avoid this in future, perhaps a confirmation step before seats are added. Thank you for your help, Lena Fischer, Operations Coordinator

subject: Refund for wrong plan, plus a question
body: Got charged $213 for the wrong plan 17 days ago. Meant to pick monthly, picked annual. Refund the $213 please and I'll redo it. Also, how do I add my logo to invoices? Cant find the option. Thanks, Tama

subject: Can't sign in, reset link expired

Gareth Pryce
