subject: First chargeback ever, feeling lost
body: Hello, I'm hoping someone can explain what's going on, because I've never dealt with this before. I run a small tour company in Queenstown, and eleven days ago one of our guests paid for a group kayaking trip through a Tallyfern invoice. The trip went ahead, the weather was great, and the guest even left us a lovely review. Then this morning I received an email saying the guest has filed a chargeback with their card provider. I don't know if it's a mistake on their end or if they're trying to get their money back for some reason, but either way I'm worried. What happens to the money now? Do I need to send you evidence, like the booking confirmation and the review? And how long do I have to respond? Thank you, Aroha

subject: We want our $2,168 back
body: You charged our account $2,168 for a premium support upgrade that nobody approved. Our enterprise agreement already includes support, and any change to it requires a signed amendment, which you don't have. I've asked our account contact twice and been ignored. Refund the full $2,168 immediately and confirm that the upgrade has been removed. If this isn't resolved this week, it will go to our legal team. Rolf Schneider, Head of Procurement

subject: Payout of $28,677 not received
body: Payout of $28,677 due yesterday, not received. Dashboard shows "completed". Bank shows nothing pending. Need a trace reference and confirmation of the destination account. Urgent, this covers payroll. Regards, Tom Aalto

subject: Refund the charge from five days ago
body: Five days ago you charged us $384 for an annual add-on that was supposed to be a free trial. Nobody told us it would convert to a paid plan, and nobody on our team of 22 has even opened it. I want the full $384 refunded today and the add-on removed. This kind of sneaky billing is exactly why people leave platforms like yours. Fix it. Daniel Price

subject: Locked out of my own account and a seat question
body: I've been locked out of my account for two days and I'm losing my mind. Every time I log in, it asks for my two-factor code, which I enter straight from my authenticator app, and it says "invalid code". I've checked the time on my phone, re-synced the app, everything. Meanwhile, I can't approve invoices, our clients aren't getting billed, and our cash flow is suffering. I need someone to get me back in today, not tomorrow. And while I've got your attention: we're planning to add another ten seats next month as we grow from 44 people, so tell me how that works and what it'll cost. But the lockout comes first. Please treat this as urgent, because right now I can't do my job. Ethan Brooks

subject: Large payout not received yet
body: Good morning, I hope you're keeping well. I'm writing about a payout of $37,602 that was scheduled to reach our business account last Wednesday. It's the proceeds from a large client project that we completed over the summer, so it's quite significant for us. The dashboard shows the payout as "sent", but our bank has confirmed that nothing has arrived, and there's no pending transfer either. We haven't changed our bank details, and previous payouts have always arrived without any trouble. Could you please look into what's happened, provide a trace reference that I can share with our bank, and let me know when we can expect the funds? We have supplier payments due at the end of the month, so I'd be very grateful for a quick reply. Many thanks for your help, Annika Svensson, Finance Manger

subject: Locked out after too many tries
body: Locked out after too many failed logins. Pretty sure I mistyped, new keybord. Need to get back in today, we have invoices due. How do I unlock it? Thanks, Leo, Fairway Accounting. No admin on our side can unlock me.

subject: Refund my $472 now
body: You charged me $472 for an annual plan 23 days ago after I had already cancelled. I'm a sole trader and I can't afford to lose that. I have the cancellation email. Refund the $472 immediately and stop charging me. Sophie Martin

subject: Payout missing, $30,493
body: Payout of $30,493 from last week not in our account. Dashboard says paid out. Bank says nothing recieved. Ten staff, this is our biggest payment of the year. Please trace and confirm today. Thanks, Petra

subject: SSO completely broken for our staff
body: Our staff can't sign in via SSO since this morning. They authenticate fine with our identity provider and then Tallyfern rejects them. Nearly a thousand people unable to work. I need this fixed now, not in a few hours. Arjun Rao, Head of IT

subject: Our subsidiaries need to come onboard
body: Three subsidiaries joining our group from January, roughly 400 people total. They need to be working in Tallyfern from day one on the same contract and SSO as us. Need pricing, an amended agreement and a provisioning timeline. Please also confirm whether their existing invoice history can be imported. Our current contract covers 1,770 users. Regards, Samantha Reed, Group Procurement

subject: Staff bounced after company sign-in
body: Staff get bounced back to the start after our company sign-in page. They complete it, then Tallyfern sends them back again. Since 7am. Most of our people affected. Nothing changed our end. Urgent. Thanks, Marco, IT

subject: What does the transaction fee cover?
body: Hello, I'm on the free plan and noticed a small transaction fee on a payment one of my clients made. I didn't realise there were fees on the free plan. Could you explain what the fee covers and how it's calculated? Thank you, Natalie

subject: v2 API errors plus adding seats
body: POST /v2/invoices failing with 500 on invoices with more than 30 line items since Monday. Invoice ref 88-301 is one example. Please fix. Also want to add 5 seats next month, how? Thanks, Ian, Kestrel Joinery

subject: Everything is failing, is this an outage?
body: Your entire platform seems to be down and nobody is saying anything. For the past hour every API call we make fails with a 503, the dashboard won't load, and our customers can't pay their invoices. Our status checks show it's not just one endpoint, it's everything. I've got nine people sitting around and customers calling. Is there an outage or not? I need an answer and an ETA right now. Tara Collins

subject: Our card issuer has disputed your charge
body: Our card issuer has opened a dispute on your charge from 66 days ago after our finance team flagged it as outside our approved budget. Before anyone starts threatening to restrict our account, I want to be clear: we have nearly two thousand staff relying on Tallyfern and any disruption is unacceptable. Tell me what you need from us to resolve the dispute and confirm our service will not be affected while it's open. Gwen Hughes, Finance Director

subject: Your v1 API changes are breaking our billing
body: I want to raise a formal complaint about the way the v1 API has been changed without notice. Since last Tuesday, responses from GET /v1/invoices no longer include the "line_items" array unless we pass an extra parameter that isn't documented anywhere. Our billing reconciliation service, which serves over thirteen hundred people across our organisation, depends on that data. We were told that the v1 API would remain stable until its retirement date, and that any changes would be announced at least ninety days in advance. Neither of those things happened. We've lost a week of reconciliation work, and our auditors are asking questions. I need confirmation of what changed, the exact parameter we now need to pass, and a commitment that there will be no further unannounced changes to v1. Margaret Hale, Director of Technology

subject: Planning a large v2 batch import
body: Hello, I'm part of the integrations team at Summit Health. We're preparing to migrate several years of historical invoices, roughly 250,000 records, into Tallyfern using the v2 API, and I wanted to check a few things before we start so that we don't cause problems for ourselves or for you. First, are there any rate limits on POST /v2/invoices that we should be aware of for a job of this size, and is there a bulk import endpoint that would be more appropriate? Second, during a test run last week, about 2% of our requests failed with a 422 error saying "issue_date cannot be more than 365 days in the past". Is there a way to import older invoices for historical records? Thanks very much, Benjamin Ortiz

subject: v1 API pagination broken
body: GET /v1/payments ignores the page parameter since yesterday and always returns page 1. Our nightly v1 sync is stuck in a loop as a result. Please check. Thanks, Callum Doyle, Doyle Freight. Request IDs available on request.

subject: v2 API broke our checkout and nobody warned us
body: I'm writing because your v2 API has now cost us a full day of sales and I want answers. Since yesterday afternoon, every request to POST /v2/payment_links returns a 400 error saying "expires_at must be a Unix timestamp", even though we've been sending ISO dates for over a year without a single problem and your own v2 documentation still shows ISO dates in the examples. Our online store generates a payment link for every order, so no customer has been able to pay since this started. We're a team of twenty and we've had to email customers one by one with manual payment instructions. I've checked the changelog and there's nothing about this. Either roll back the change or tell me exactly what format you now expect, today. And next time you change v2 behaviour, tell your customers first. Liam Sinclair, Sinclair Outdoor Co.

subject: API is rejecting our customer updates
body: For two days every PATCH request to update a customer through your API returns a 409 "version conflict" error, even when nobody else is editing that customer. We've tried fetching the latest record first and sending it straight back, same result. This is blocking our whole CRM sync. I want to know what's causing it and how to fix it today. We're a team of 29 and this is wasting everyone's time. Rob Kerr

subject: Refund the $63 you charged me
body: You charged me $63 almost three months ago, 88 days to be exact, for an add-on I never wanted. I only noticed now going thru my statements. Refund the $63. I don't care how small it is, I never agreed to it. Sort it out. Kerry Wells

subject: Seat change request and an invoice error
body: I asked last week to reduce our enterprise seats from 70 to 55 at renewal and got no reply. Renewal is in a fortnight. Send me the revised contract. Also, your latest invoice lists 74 seats, not 70, so I want an explanation of that line before I approve payment. Two problems from one supplier in one month is not a good look. Jennifer Cole, Office Director

subject: Adding seats for our new team
body: Hello, we currently have 52 seats on the Pro plan, and we're setting up a new client services team that will need about twelve more. Could you let me know how adding seats would affect our pricing, and whether there's a better option for a team of our size? We'd like everything in place by the start of next month. Thank you, Oliver Pratt, Pratt & Lowe Associates

subject: API returns duplicate payments
body: When we list payments through your API, some payments appear twice in the response with the same ID but different timestamps. Started this week. It's breaking our reconciliation, which runs nightly. We're two people and rely on this. Is this expected behaviour? If so, how should we deduplicate? We've checked our own code and we only call the list endpoint once per page, so the duplicates aren't coming from our side. Thanks, Hannes, Weber Design

subject: v1 refunds returning incorrect amounts
body: Hello, our v1 integration creates refunds through POST /v1/refunds, and since yesterday the refunded amount shown in the dashboard is ten times the amount we sent. Could you check whether something changed in how v1 handles amounts? We've paused refunds for now. Thank you, Graham, Northfield Joinery

subject: Our account has been compromised
body: Someone got into our Tallyfern account overnight and sent fake invoices to our clients with their own bank details. Three clients have already paid. This is a disaster. Lock our account, stop those payments, and call me now. Danny Russo, Russo Contracting

subject: Users can't sign in this morning
body: Many users unable to sign in since 8am Eastern. Some report password resets not arriving, others get stuck after our company sign-in page. About 1,888 users on the account. Please investigate. Regards, Monique Allen, IT Service Desk

subject: Getting our logo onto invoices
body: Hello, our invoices go out with just plain text at the top and I'd love our logo and colours to show instead, like the examples on your website. I'm on my own so I set everthing up myself and might have missed something. Where would I do that? Thank you, Sione

subject: Refund for an accidental upgrade
body: Upgraded to the annual premium plan by mistake six days ago, charged $499. Meant to choose monthly. Switched back the same day. No premium features used by our three users. Please refund the $499 to the card on file and confirm by email. We'll stay on our current plan for now. Small business, so the refund matters to us. Let me know if you need anything else to process it. Thanks, Hanna Berg

subject: Refund for an add-on activated during training
body: Hello, I'm writing on behalf of the finance systems team at Mercy Valley Health. Three days ago, during a staff training session, one of our trainers was demonstrating the add-ons page and accidentaly activated the advanced forecasting add-on for our whole organisation. We were charged $329 for it immediately. We noticed within the hour and deactivated it, and as far as we can tell nobody used it in the meantime. Given that we have nearly two thousand people on our enterprise account, I'd also love to know whether there's a way to restrict add-on purchases to account owners only, so this doesn't happen again during future trainings. In the meantime, could you please refund the $329 to the card on file and confirm once it's been processed? Thank you very much, Theresa Morgan

subject: API errors everywhere and dashboard won't load
body: Hi there, I'm the lead developer at a mid-sized property management company, and I wanted to report what looks like a broader problem. Since roughly 1pm Eastern, every single request our systems make to the Tallyfern API has been failing, not just one or two endpoints, but invoices, customers, payments, the lot, all returning 503 errors. At first I assumed it was something in our code, so I rolled back our last deploy, but nothing changed. Then our accounts team mentioned that the Tallyfern dashboard wasn't loading for them either, and a couple of tenants have emailed to say the payment links in their rent invoices are showing an error page. We have 46 people on our account and nobody can do anything. Is there an incident on your side, and is there anywhere we can follow updates? Thanks, Raj Patel

subject: Refund for the wrong plan, please
body: Hello, I'm so sorry to trouble you with this. Eight days ago I was updating our account settings to add a new staff member, and somewhere along the way I must have clicked the wrong button, because I ended up being charged $376 for an annual upgrade we hadn't planned on. We're a small family-run nursery with seven people using Tallyfern, and that's a fair bit of money for us. I switched the plan back as soon as I noticed, and none of the upgraded features were used in the meantime. Would you be able to refund the $376 to our card? I'd also be grateful if there's a way to add a confirmation step before upgrades, as I'm not very confident with these things. Thank you so much for your patience, Margaret Fong

subject: Funds from my clients haven't come through
body: Hello, I hope you can help me understand what's happened. I'm a freelance photographer, and last week two of my clients paid their invoices through Tallyfern, $1,394 between them. The invoices show as paid, and normally the money turns up in my business account a couple of days later. This time it hasn't arrived at all. I've checked with my bank, and they can't see anything incoming or pending. When I looked in Tallyfern, the transfer to my bank has a small red warning next to it, but it doesn't say what went wrong or whether I need to do anything. I haven't changed my bank details or anything else on the account. I'd be really grateful if someone could check what's going on and let me know when I can expect the money. Thank you, Laura Bianchi

subject: Refund for the onboarding add-on
body: Hello, we were charged $510 for a premium onboarding add-on that we didn't request. Our team already completed onboarding last year. Could you please refund the $510 to our card on file and remove the add-on from our account? Thank you, Anthony Russo, Finance

subject: Help understanding API response times
body: Hello, I'm part of the integrations team at Ashford & Lane, a professional services firm. Over the past week we've noticed that requests to your API that create invoices with attachments are taking much longer than they used to, sometimes over twenty seconds, whereas invoices without attachments are created almost instantly. Occasionally the slow requests time out entirely on our side, and when we retry we sometimes end up with duplicate invoices. We'd love to understand whether attachments are processed synchronously, whether there's a recommended maximum file size, and whether there's a better pattern for attaching documents, such as uploading them separately first. Any guidance would be very welcome. Thank you, Evelyn Ward

subject: Request for all data about our firm
body: Hi all! We're doing a bit of a data housekeeping exercise at our accountancy practice, and as part of that I'd like to formally ask for a copy of all the information Tallyfern holds about our firm and the fifty people on our account. That would include user details, logins, invoices, client records and any notes. Could you let me know the process and how long it usualy takes? I'm happy to sign anything you need. Thanks ever so much, Polly

subject: Refund for an accidental purchase
body: Hi there, I'm a bit embarrassed to be writing in about this. I'm a sole trader running a small dog-walking business, and I use Tallyfern on the free plan to send invoices to my clients. Five days ago I was clicking around trying to find out how to add my logo, and I somehow ended up buying the premium branding pack for $262. I didn't realise until I saw the charge on my bank app the next morning. I haven't used any of the premium features, and honestly I don't need them, because my clients are happy with plain invoices. Is there any chance I could get the $262 back? It's a lot of money for me right now. Thank you so much for reading this, Amy Clarke

subject: v1 customer search broken
body: GET /v1/customers?email= returns all customers instead of filtering since yesterday. Our v1 integration uses it to match payers, so now every payment matches the wrong customer. Had to pause our sync. 23 users affected. Is the email filter still suported on v1? Need a fix or workaround. We match around three hundred payments a day this way and our bookkeeper is now matching them by hand, which is not sustainable. Thanks, Rangi

subject: Expanding to our Nordic offices
body: Hello, I'm the procurement manager at Baltic & Nordic Logistics. We've been on Tallyfern's enterprise plan since last spring with 1,834 users, and we're now planning to bring our offices in Oslo, Stockholm and Helsinki onto the platform. That's roughly 300 additional people, and we'd like them to be up and running by the beginning of February, ahead of our fiscal year starting on 1 March. Could you put together pricing for the additional seats and any changes to our agreement? On a separate note, our team would like to know how to set up invoices in Norwegian kroner and Swedish krona, since the new offices bill locally. Is there a way to set a default currency per office or business unit? Thank you, Erik Johansson

subject: Intermittent SSO failures across the organisation
body: Hello, I'm the identity and access manager at Riverside Financial Group, and I'm hoping you can help with an issue that's been building over the past few days. Since roughly Thursday, a growing number of our staff have been unable to get into Tallyfern through single sign-on. They complete authentication with our identity provider as normal, but when they're redirected back to Tallyfern, about one in four attempts ends with an "invalid SAML response" error. Trying again sometimes works, sometimes doesn't. We have over seventeen hundred people on our account, so even a partial failure rate means dozens of support calls a day. We haven't changed anything in our SSO configuration, and our identity provider shows no errors on its side. Could someone look at our connection logs and help us understand what's going on? Thank you, Natasha Ivanova

subject: Why is adding seats so difficult?
body: I've been trying to add six more seats to our Pro account for a week. The settings page says "contact us", the chat bot loops, and my email from Monday has no reply. We're at 49 users and have new starters next week. I don't need a sales pitch, I just want to pay for the seats. Either fix the settings page or add them for me. Seriosuly, this shouldn't be this hard. Lukas Brandt

subject: Locked out after travelling
body: Hello, my account was locked after I tried to log in from a hotel abroad and couldn't complete the extra verification step. Everything on the account looks normal when my colleague checks it. Could you please unlock it so I can log in again? Thank you, Isabel Grant

subject: Explain why our bill keeps changing
body: I'm sick of trying to work out our Tallyfern bill every month. We have six users on the Pro plan, we haven't added or removed anyone in a year, and yet our invoice has been a different amount every single month since June. Sometimes there's a "processing" line, sometimes there's a "platform" line, sometimes there's a currency adjustment, and none of it is explained anywhere I can find. I'm not asking for a refund right now, I want someone to sit down and explain each line on our last three invoices in plain English, and tell me what our bill is actually supposed to be each month. If I can't predict what I'm paying, I can't budget, and if I can't budget, I'll find a supplier I can understand. Michelle Tan

subject: Payout of $9,434 hasn't arrived
body: Hello, our payout of $9,434 was due to arrive in our bank account two days ago, but it still hasn't come through. The dashboard shows the payout as failed, but doesn't give a reason. Our bank details are the same as they've always been. Could you check what went wrong and whether it will be resent? Thank you, Karen Doyle, Doyle Vision Care

subject: Still waiting on seat pricing
body: I asked two weeks ago what it would cost to grow from 50 seats on Pro to around 70. Still no answer. We've got new staff joining and I can't keep putting off the decision. Send me the pricing and tell me whether we should be on a diferent plan at this size. Honestly the slow repsonse is making me reconsider Tallyfern altogether. Ben Wu, Operations Manager

subject: Refund an old charge, and how do I export invoices?
body: You charged me $39 for an add-on 53 days ago that I cancelled during the trial. I raised it with your chat back then, reference 4471-K, and nothing happened. Refund the $39 now. I know it's small but it's the principle. Separately, how do I export all my invoices from last tax year to CSV? Your help article mentions a button that doesn't exist. Rick Hollis

subject: SSO issues and a question about our invoice
body: Hello, I'm hoping you can help with a couple of things. First, and most urgent, since our identity provider rolled out a new multi-factor policy last week, a portion of our staff in our Singapore and Hong Kong offices have been unable to get into Tallyfern through single sign-on. They complete the new multi-factor step successfully, but Tallyfern then shows a "session expired" error and sends them back to the start. Staff in our Australian offices don't seem to be affected, which is puzzling. With over eighteen hundred people on the account, it's generating a lot of helpdesk calls. Second, and much less urgent, our latest invoice includes a line called "regional hosting" that we haven't seen before, and our finance team has asked me to find out what it covers. Thank you, Christopher Leung

subject: SSO outage for our staff, again
body: For the second time this month, our staff can't get into Tallyfern through single sign-on. Since 7am they authenticate with our identity provider and then Tallyfern throws an "assertion expired" error. We have over seventeen hundred people on this account and half of them are sitting idle. I need this fixed now, and I want a root cause this time, not just "it's resolved". Jason Clarke, IT Director

subject: Your login keeps rejecting my code
body: Third day I can't get in. Password fine, then the six-digit code from my app gets rejected every single time. I approve every invoice in our department. Get me back in today. Megan Cross

subject: Nobody can pay us and we can't log in
body: What on earth is going on? Since about 2pm, my clients have been calling to say they can't pay their invoices because the payment page just shows an error. I tried to log in to check, and the dashboard won't load at all, it spins and then gives up. My business partner tried from her phone at home, same thing. I tried the mobile app, same thing. We're a four-person team and we live on these payments. I've refreshed everything, cleared everything, and checked our internet, which is fine. This is not a problem on our side. I need to know when it'll be working again, because I'm about to start telling clients to pay by bank transfer instead, and that's a mess for our books. Someone please tell us what's happening. Rhiannon Price

subject: Your invoice is wrong AND our bank has disputed it
body: I want an explanation of your last invoice to us, because it's nearly double what we normally pay and nobody here can work out why. Our seat count hasn't changed, we haven't bought any add-ons, and the line items make no sense. And since your billing team ignored my first two emails about it, our corporate card issuer has now raised a chargeback on the charge at our finance team's request. I'm not going to apologise for that. Before you start sending us threats about restricting our account, understand that we have 865 people relying on Tallyfern every day. I want a proper breakdown of the invoice, and I want someone senior to contact me to sort out the dispute properly. This has been handled apallingly. Sarah Whitmore, Finance Director

subject: Payout failed and I'm not sure why
body: Hi there, I'm hoping you can help me get to the bottom of a payout problem. We run a small chain of three bakeries, and every week our takings from Tallyfern invoices are paid out to our business account. This week's payout was $9,590, which is about normal for us at this time of year. It was supposed to arrive on Wednesday, but on Thursday morning I got an email saying the payout "could not be completed" and that the funds were returned to our Tallyfern balance. There was no explanation of why. I checked with our bank, and they say nothing was rejected on their end. Our bank details haven't changed in years. Could you please look into what happened, tell me whether the payout will be retried, and whether there's anything I need to do on my side? Thank you, Gina Russo

subject: Our v1 integration is failing on large invoices
body: Hello, I'm the developer at a small events company, and I maintain an integration that sends ticket sales into Tallyfern through the v1 API. It was built a few years ago, and it's been very reliable until recently. Since the start of this month, any invoice we create through POST /v1/invoices with more than about 200 line items fails with a 413 "payload too large" error. That's a problem for us, because our big conferences generate invoices with hundreds of ticket lines. Smaller invoices still work perfectly. Is there a new size limit on v1 requests, and if so, is there a recommended way to split large invoices or attach line items separately? We're not in a position to rebuild on a newer version before our next conference. Thank you, Daniel Hughes

subject: Refund for a duplicate add-on charge
body: Charged twice for the same reporting add-on 12 days ago, $366 each. Only one is valid. Please refund the duplicate $366 to the card on file. Our accounts team flagged it during reconciliation. We have 1,983 users on the enterprise plan. Please confirm by email once processed so we can close the item. Please also check whether any other add-ons on our account were billed twice in the same run. Regards, Hugh Bennett, Accounts Payable

subject: Add seats to my account NOW
body: I've been trying to add five seats for three days. We're at 45 people on Pro. The settings page keeps erroring and nobody replies to email. My new hires can't work. Add the seats or tell me how, today. Paul Grant

subject: Renewal and expansion planning for next year
body: Hello, I'm the head of business systems at Pacific Crest Group, and I'm starting our planning for next year's Tallyfern renewal. We currently have 1,211 people on our enterprise plan, and it's been a real success, especially in our finance and operations teams. Over the next twelve months we expect to grow by about 30%, partly through hiring and partly through an acquisition we're finalising, so we're likely to need somewhere around 1,600 seats by the end of next year. I'd love to discuss a renewal that builds in that growth, whether there's a pricing structure that rewards a longer commitment, and how we'd handle seats for the acquired company, which may join mid-term. Could we arrange a meeting in the next few weeks? Many thanks, Hiroko Tanaka

subject: Old API integration started failing
body: Our order system talks to Tallyfern through the legacy API it was built on in 2018. Since yesterday, creating invoices fails with "customer_id must be a string". We send numbers, always have. Three users, small shop. Nothing changed our side. What changed on yours, and what's the quickest fix? We can't rebuild the integration this month, so a workaround would be ideal. Thanks, Joachim

subject: Refund for an add-on we didn't mean to buy
body: Hello, six days ago we were charged $346 for the premium reporting add-on. I think one of our team clicked on it by accident while exploring the reports page. None of our nine users have used it, and we've already switched it off. Could you please refund the $346 to our card on file? We'd really apreciate it. Thank you, Lisa Hammond, Hammond Florists

subject: SSO sign-in errors
body: Staff can't sign in through single sign-on since this morning. After our identity provider step they get "account disabled" from Tallyfern, but accounts aren't disabled. About 200 users. Please check. Regards, Tobias Klein, IT

subject: Refund for an add-on activated by mistake
body: Hello, I hope your week is off to a good start. I'm writing about a charge we noticed on our card statement this morning. Sixteen days ago, our account was charged $510 for the premium analytics add-on, which I believe was switched on by one of our team leads while they were exploring the reports section. They thought they were opening a free preview, and they didn't realise it would start a paid subscription. As far as we can tell, nobody on our team of 53 has actually used the add-on since then, and we've now switched it off. Could you please refund the $510 to the card on file and confirm once that's done? I'd also be grateful for any advice on restricting add-on purchases to admins only, so this doesn't happen again. Many thanks, Rachel Simmons

subject: v1 webhook retries not happening
body: Failed v1 webhook deliveries are not being retried since Tuesday. Our endpoint had a short outage and those events are lost. v1 webhook log shows a single attempt each. Please confirm retry behaviour and whether you can resend. Regards, Samuel Ortiz, Platform Engineering

subject: Refund the $1,761 charge
body: Charged $1,761 for a premium support package we never ordered. Our plan already includes support. Please refund the full $1,761 to the card on file and remove the package. Confirm by email when done. Regards, Michael Ford, Finance

subject: Tallyfern unavailable for our organisation
body: Hello, since around 11am Eastern, none of our staff can load the Tallyfern dashboard, and our clients report that payment pages are showing errors. Could you please confirm whether there's an incident and share an expected resolution time? Thank you, Laura Whitman, IT Operations

subject: Request to delete our data
body: Hello, we're closing our Tallyfern account and would like all the personal data you hold about our company and our 14 users deleted. Could you let me know what the proccess is and confirm once it's done? Thank you, Jean-Marc Leblanc

subject: Question about our invoice tax
body: Our latest Tallyfern invoice shows sales tax for a state where we have no presence. Why is that tax applied, and how do we update our billing address so it's correct? Not disputing yet, just need to understand. Regards, Catherine Bell, Accounts
