I run a tiny bookbinding workshop with my husband, and some years ago a friend set up a little integration for us that creates invoices in Tallyfern through the v1 API whenever we log an order in our spreadsheet. It's been wonderful, but since last week the invoices it creates are all showing the wrong due date, exactly one day earlier than the date we send. I've checked the spreadsheet and the dates there are correct. My friend thinks it might be a time zone change in the v1 API, but neither of us is sure. Is there anything we should change in the request so that the due dates come out right? We'd be very greatful for any advice, as we don't really have anyone technical to ask. Thank you kindly, Margaret Hollins

subject: Refund small duplicate charge
body: Charged $114 twice for one seat 15 days ago. Please refund one of the $114 charges to the card on file. Statment attached. Thanks, Dev Patel, Patel Accounting. We have 31 seats and only one seat change that day.

subject: Increasing seats for our new office
body: Hello, we're opening a new office in Edinburgh early next year and expect to add around 60 people to our enterprise account, which currently has 470 seats. Could you please send an updated quote and let us know how the new seats would be added to our existing agreement? We'd also like the new staff to use our existing single sign-on setup. Thank you, Fiona Campbell, Operations Director

subject: Platform unreachable for all users
body: API returning 503 on all endpoints since 10:15 CET. Dashboard won't load. Customers can't open payment links. All 45 users affected. Is there an incident? Please confirm and share an ETA. Thanks, Johan Berg, IT

subject: Password reset I didn't ask for
body: Hello, I received a password reset email I didn't request, and shortly after, a notification that two-factor authentication had been disabled on my account. I'm worried someone is trying to get in. Could you please lock the account and help me secure it? Thank you, Simone Dubois, IT Securty

subject: How to set up invoice reminders, and a fee question
body: Hi everyone! I'm still getting used to Tallyfern, so apologies if these are silly questions. First, I'd love to set up automatic reminders for clients whose invoices are overdue, ideally one a week after the due date and another after two weeks. I can see a reminders section in settings, but I'm not sure how to set the timing. Second, I noticed a small "processing" line on our last Tallyfern bill and wondered what it covers. Thanks so much, Saoirse

subject: That big charge from you last month
body: Hello, the $1,417 that came off our card for "premium onboarding" was never agreed. We have 19 users and onboarding was included in our plan. Order ref 2207 on the receipt. Could we have it back, please? Thank you, Paolo Rinaldi

subject: Seat pricing above 50 users
body: We have 54 seats on Pro, adding about 15 more over the next quarter. Need pricing for that, plus options for annual billing. Is there a plan better suited to our size? Please send a quote by Friday. Our finance director wants to compare it with two other suppliers before signing anything. We'd also want to know whether new seats can be added mid-term at the same rate. Thanks, Hélène, Gagnon Constructon

subject: v1 errors and a question about reminders
body: Hello, I hope you can help me with two things. First, our little online shop uses an integration built on the v1 API to create invoices whenever someone places an order. Since last Tuesday, about one in three orders fails to appear in Tallyfern, and when I checked the logs, the v1 API was returning a 429 error saying "too many requests", even though we only get a few orders an hour. I didn't think we were anywhere near any limit. Is there a new rate limit on v1, or could something else be going on? Second, a much simpler question: is there a way to send an automatic thank-you email to customers once they've paid an invoice? I couldn't find it in the settings, but I might have missed it. We're just three people, so any guidence is very welcome. Thank you, Isabelle

subject: Payout delayed for over a week
body: Hello, I'm getting a bit worried about a payout that seems to have gone missing. We're a small graphic design agency in Melbourne with eighteen people, and we use Tallyfern to invoice all our clients. On the 3rd, the dashboard showed a payout of $5,394 being sent to our business bank account, which normally arrives within two business days. It's now been well over a week and the money still hasn't appeared. Our bank says they haven't received anything, not even a pending transfer. Our bank details haven't changed, and we've had payouts arrive without any trouble for the past two years. Could you please check what's happened, give me a trace reference I can pass to our bank, and let me know when we can expect the money? Thank you, Olivia Harper

subject: I think my account has been taken over
body: Hi, I'm really worried and not sure what to do. I'm a freelance tutor and I use Tallyfern to send invoices to the families I work with. This morning, two parents messaged me asking why I'd sent them new invoices with a different bank account for payment. I didn't send anything. When I logged in, I found three invoices I never created, and my email address on the account had been changed to one I don't recognise, although I could still log in with my password. I've changed my password now, but I don't know how they got in or whether they can still access my acount. I'm also scared that one of the parents has already paid into that other account. Could you please help me lock everything down and tell me what they did? Thank you, Mai Nguyen

subject: Chargeback notice on a client payment
body: Hello, I've just received a notice that one of my clients has filed a chargeback on a payment they made through my Tallyfern invoice. I'm a freelance consultant and I've never had this happen before. The client hasn't contacted me about any problem with the work. Could you explain what happens next, what evidence I should send, and how long I have to respond? Thank you, Jessica Moore

subject: v1 API returning stale data
body: Hello, since yesterday GET /v1/invoices/{id} returns stale data for invoices that were updated recently. For example, an invoice we marked as paid an hour ago still shows as unpaid through the v1 API, though the dashboard shows it correctly. Is there caching on v1 responses now? This is causing our reminder system to chase clients who have already paid, which is embarassing. Thank you, Brian Walsh

subject: Money taken on 5 August for a training bundle
body: Good afternoon, I hope this finds you well. While reconciling last month's card statement, our finance team found a charge of $377 that Tallyfern took on 5 August for a "team training bundle". As far as we can tell, nobody here asked for it, and the sessions it includes were never booked. We're a large organisation with over 1,800 people on our account, and I appreciate that someone may have clicked something by accident, but we'd still like the $377 returned, please. Our purchase order system, PO 55-9013, has no record of it. Kind regards, Grace Ho

subject: Adding seats for a new subsidiary
body: Hello, we've recently acquired a smaller firm, and we'd like to bring their staff onto our Tallyfern enterprise account. That would take us from 444 seats to roughly 520. Could you please send an updated quote and explain how we'd add the new users to our existing agreement and single sign-on setup? We'd like everything ready by the start of next quarter. Thank you, Thomas Reid, Business Systems

subject: Chargeback on a $1,871 payment
body: A client just filed a chargeback on the $1,871 they paid through our invoice. The work was finished and they signed off. I want to fight this. Tell me exactly what you need and the deadline, today. Callum Ward

subject: Question about our seat charges
body: Our invoice shows 31 seats at two different prices. Why? Same plan for everyone. Please explain. Not disputing it yet, just need to understand it for budgeting. Thanks, Sophie Grant, Grant Interiors. Please reply by email.

subject: Invoices we never created
body: Five invoices on our account this morning that nobody here created, all with a bank account that isn't ours, sent to our clients overnight. Our admins deny it. Need help now. Kyle Turner

subject: Request for a copy of my data
body: Requesting a copy of all personal data you hold on me and my small business. Three users on our account. Include account details, logins, invoices and client records. Please confirm receipt, the timeline, and what ID you need. Electronic copy preferred, sent to the account email. If any data is held by third parties on your behalf, please list them as well. I'd like to understand exactly where our information sits. Thanks, Nina Kowalski, Kowalski Translation Services

subject: Refund for an accidental add-on
body: Hello, three weeks ago an add-on was accidentally activated on our account during a training session, and we were charged for it. We've switched it off and it hasn't been used. Could you please refund the charge? Thank you, Ming Zhao

subject: Formal request for all data held on our firm
body: Hello, I'm the office manager at Whitmore & Clarke Solicitors in Bath. As a law firm, we're particularly careful about the data we hold and share, and our partners have asked me to request a complete copy of all the personal information Tallyfern holds about our firm, our 51 staff and our clients. That would include our account details, user profiles, login history, the client records and invoices we've created, any notes your team has made about our account, and details of any third parties with whom our data has been shared. Could you please confirm receipt of this request, let me know what identity checks you require, and tell me when we can expect to receive the information? Many thanks, Eleanor Davies

subject: Still no copy of our data
body: I asked for a copy of all the data you hold about our company and our 57 users nearly four weeks ago, and I've heard nothing back except an automated reply. This is a legal request with a legal deadline, and you're about to miss it. I want the full copy sent to me this week, along with an apology for the delay. If it doesn't arrive, I'll escalate this formally. Harriet Lewis, Director

subject: Refund for a support upgrade we didn't approve
body: Hello, I'm reaching out from the finance team at Laurentian Health. Our account was recently charged $1,004 for an upgrade to a priority support tier that nobody on our side approved. We believe it may have been switched on automaticaly after a trial ended. Our enterprise agreement already includes support, so we'd like the $1,004 refunded and the upgrade removed. Thank you, Claire Bouchard, Finance Operations

subject: Is Tallyfern down?
body: Hello, since about 11am CET I can't load the Tallyfern dashboard, and my clients tell me the payment links on their invoices show an error page. Is there an outage at the moment? Thank you, Katharina, Weiss Design

subject: Refund for an old charge
body: Found a charge from 100 days ago for an add-on we never ordered. Please refund it in full and confirm it won't renew. Our procurement team requires a credit note. Regards, Simon Clarke, Accounts Payable

subject: Payout details changed, not by us
body: Our payout bank details were changed overnight. Nobody here did it. Freeze payouts and change it back. Payout due tomorrow. Call me on the number on file. We've also had two odd login alerts this week that none of us recognise. Owen Davies, Davies Builders

subject: SSO sign-in failing for part of our staff
body: Hello, since our identity provider migrated to a new data centre last night, about a third of our staff have been unable to sign in to Tallyfern through single sign-on. They see an "invalid signature" error after authenticating. The rest of our 1,881 users are fine. Could you check whether our SSO connection needs updating? Thank you, Kimberly Ross, Identity Engineering

subject: v2 migration questions before cutover
body: Hello, I'm part of the platform team at Bayside Health, and we're about to complete our migration from the old API onto v2. Most things have gone smoothly, but we've hit one issue we'd like to resolve before we cut over for good. On v2, when we update an invoice through PATCH /v2/invoices/{id}, any line items we don't include in the request are deleted, whereas on the previous version, omitted lines were left untouched. That's caused a couple of nasty surprises in testing. Is this intended v2 behaviour, and if so, is there a way to update a single line without resending the whole invoice? We'd also love to know whether there's a dry-run option for v2 updates, so we can validate changes before applying them. Thank you, Steven Park

subject: Understanding API errors from our booking system
body: Hello, we run a group of physiotherapy clinics, and our booking software sends each appointment into Tallyfern as an invoice through your API. Over the past week, our booking provider says they've seen a growing number of 400 errors with the message "invalid service_date". They've shared a few examples with me, and the dates look perfectly normal, mostly appointments booked a few weeks in advance. As far as we can tell, the failures only happen for appointments more than thirty days in the future. Nobody on our side has changed anything. Could you help us understand whether there's a limit on how far ahead the service date can be, and whether that's new? Our booking provider is happy to adjust their integration if needed. Thank you, Rebecca Lim

subject: Fix your v1 API now
body: Your v1 API has returned 500 on every GET /v1/customers call since 6am. Our app is useless without it. Five users here and none of us can work. I need this fixed this morning, not "investigated". Toby Marsh, Marsh Electrcal

subject: Overdue data request and a billing complaint
body: I'm writing for the second time. Five weeks ago I asked for a complete copy of all the personal data Tallyfern holds about our company and our 23 users. I received only an automated acknowledgement. Under data protection law you have a deadline to respond, and you've already gone past it. I want the full copy of our data sent to me this week. While I'm at it, I also want an explanation of our latest invoice from you, which includes a "compliance services" line that I've never seen before and that nobody here agreed to. I'm not asking for a refund of it at this point, I want to know what it is and why it's there. If I don't receive both the data and a clear answer on the invoice by Friday, I will be raising a formal complaint with the regulator. Annette Vogel, Managing Director

subject: SSO login loops for some staff
body: Hi, hope your day is going well. We've had a strange issue since Tuesday where a handful of our staff, mostly people working from our Frankfurt office, get stuck in a loop when they try to sign in through single sign-on. They authenticate with our identity provider, get sent back to Tallyfern, and then straight back to the identity provider again. Most of our nearly two thousand users are fine. Could you take a look at our SSO setup? Thanks, Matthias

subject: Login problems and some things that worry me
body: Hi, I'm not sure whether this is just a login problem or something more serious, so I thought I'd explain everything. Yesterday I couldn't log in to Tallyfern because my password suddenly stopped working. I reset it and got back in, but then I noticed a few things that didn't feel right. There was a login from a city I've never been to, at a time when I was asleep. The phone number on my profile had been changed, so my two-factor codes were going to a number I don't recognise. And one of our recurring invoices had its payment instructions edited. I've changed everything back and set a new password, but I'm worried someone still has access, and I'd like your help checking what else they might have done and making sure the account is secure. Thanks, Tom Fletcher

subject: Our staff can't get in, again
body: For the second day running, dozens of our staff can't get into Tallyfern. Some say password reset does nothing, others are stuck at our company sign-in page. We have over fourteen hundred people on this account. I need someone technical on this today, not tomorrow. Marta Kovac, IT Manager

subject: Pricing for additional seats
body: At 50 seats on Pro. Need 10 more next month. What's the price, and is there a better plan for our size? Please send options this week. We also want to know if annual billing lowers the per-seat cost. Thanks, Nate, Ironbridge Studios

subject: Request for a copy of my data
body: Requesting a copy of all personal data Tallyfern holds about me. I'm a sole trader in Vienna, the only user on my account. Include account details, logins, invoices and client records. Please confirm receipt and the timeline. Electronic copy is fine. Let me know if you need ID from me. I'd also like to know whether any of my data has been shared with other companies, and if so, which ones. Danke, Lena Huber

subject: Can't log in and nobody is helping
body: I've been locked out of my account for two days. Every time I reset my password, the new one works once and then stops working the next time I log in. I've done this four times now. Your chat bot keeps sending me the same help article. I'm one of 35 people on our account and I send most of our invoices. I want a real person to fix this today. Sharon Mills

subject: Could we have a copy of our records?
body: Hi there, hope you're having a lovely week! Our practice manager has asked me to gather copies of all the information our suppliers keep about us, as part of a big tidy-up we're doing before the new year. Would you be able to send us a copy of everything Tallyfern holds on our company and the 55 people on our account? Account details, user info, logins, that sort of thing. Let me know what you need from me. Many thanks, Bethan, Llewellyn & Co. Accountnts

subject: Refund for an accidental training add-on
body: Our account was charged $495 for the training add-on, which was activated by mistake during an admin session. It has not been used by any of our 502 users. Please refund the $495 to the card on file and confirm by email. We'd also like add-on purchases limited to account owners going forward. This is the second accidental activation this year, so a permission setting would really help us. Regards, Natalie Chen, Billing Administration

subject: Two-factor code not arriving
body: Not receiving my two-factor code by text since yesterday. Phone number is correct. Other services text me fine. Need access today to approve invoices. How can I verify another way? Regards, Daniel Lee

subject: v1 integration issues and planning to downsize
body: Hello, I'm writing about a problem with our integration and a separate question about our account. Our client portal still uses the v1 API to fetch invoices and payment status for our customers, and since last week, requests to GET /v1/invoices are taking more than ten seconds to respond, compared with under a second before. Sometimes they time out entirely, which leaves our customers staring at a spinning wheel. We haven't changed anything on our side, and our hosting provider says the delay is in your response. Is there a known slowdown on v1, or something we can do to speed things up? On a separate note, we're restructuring next quarter and expect to reduce our team from 31 to around 25 people, so I'd like to know how to remove seats and whether that affects our pricing. Thank you, Paul Ricci

subject: How to export payments report
body: How do I export a payments report for last quarter? Can't find it. Also, a staff member got an email "from Tallyfern" asking her to re-enter her login on another site, and she did. Not sure if that's a problem. Thanks, Jun

subject: Locked out of my account again
body: This is the second time this month I've been locked out. I enter my password, which I know is correct, and I'm told it's wrong. After three tries, I'm locked out for an hour. I reset my password last time, and the same thing has happened again. I approve invoices for a team of over a thousand people, so every hour I'm locked out causes a backlog. Find out what's actually wrong and fix it. Adrian Price

subject: Mixed sign-in problems across our offices
body: Hello, I'm the IT support lead at Kranz & Partner, and I'm hoping you can help us untangle a sign-in problem that's been rumbling on for a few days. Around thirty of our staff, spread across our Munich and Vienna offices, have been unable to get into Tallyfern. The symptoms seem to vary. Some people say they tried the "forgot password" link and never received an email, while others get as far as our company sign-in page, enter their details, and are then sent back to the start. Our helpdesk has tried clearing caches and testing different browsers without any luck. Most of our 731 users are unaffected, which makes it harder to pin down. Could someone look at our account and tell us what might be going on? Thank you, Stefan Kranz

subject: How to add a second approver
body: How do we require two approvers for invoices over a certain amount? We have 545 users and need this for our internal controls. Where is the setting, and can it vary by department? Please send a link to the right article if there is one. Regards, Wei Lin, Finance Systems

subject: Refund for annual plan charge
body: Charged $877 for an annual upgrade I didn't intend to buy. I'm a single user on Starter and I only wanted the monthly plan. Please refund the $877 and keep me on monthly Starter. Thank you, Jean Tremblay, Tremblay Consulting

subject: Wondering what information you keep about us
body: Hello, I hope this message finds you well. I'm the operations manager at a small architecture studio in Brighton, and I've recently been asked by our directors to put together a list of all the information that our software suppliers hold about us. Tallyfern is one of the main ones, since we've been using it for invoicing for nearly four years. Rather than trying to piece it together myself from the dashboard, I wondered whether you could send us a copy of everything you hold about our company and the 25 people on our account, including user details, login records, invoices, client information and any notes your team may have. I'm not sure if there's a formal process for this, so please let me know if you need anything from us. Kind regards, Hannah Forsyth

subject: Half our company bounced out of Tallyfern
body: I don't know what you've changed, but since this morning half of our people can't get into Tallyfern at all. They click the button to sign in with our company account, go through our identity provider like they always do, and then get dumped onto a Tallyfern page saying their session couldn't be established. We have nearly a thousand staff on this account, and our helpdesk is drowning in calls. Nobody on our side has touched the identity provider configuration in months, I checked personally. We pay for an enterprise plan precisely so this kind of thing doesn't happen. I want an engineer looking at our sign-in connection right now, and a written explanation of what went wrong once it's fixed. Gerhard Lang, Head of IT

subject: Account changed without my knowledge
body: Email and phone on my account changed overnight. Not by me. Got locked out, then back in via reset. Lock it down and tell me what was accessed. Two of us on the account and neither made the change. Urgent. Thanks, Molly Grant

subject: A client's bank took back a payment
body: Hello, I'm hoping you can help me understand something that happened this week. Last month, one of our clients paid a $2,597 invoice through Tallyfern for a kitchen installation we completed. Everything seemed fine, and they even sent us a thank-you note. But yesterday we noticed that the payment had been reversed, and the notification said the client's card company had pulled the money back after the client raised a complaint with them. The client hasn't said anything to us, and we have a signed completion form and photos of the finished work. I'm not sure what the process is from here, or whether we're likely to get the money back. Could you explain what we need to do, what evidence would help, and how long we have to respond? Thank you, Gemma Thornton

subject: Single sign-on errors after our IdP upgrade
body: Hello, I'm the systems administrator at Northwind Consulting Group. Over the weekend, our identity provider was upgraded to a new major version, and since Monday morning our staff have been unable to sign in to Tallyfern through single sign-on. After authenticating with our identity provider, they're redirected back to Tallyfern and see an error saying "unsupported SAML binding". We have 81 people on our account, and all of them are affected. Our identity provider's documentation suggests that the new version defaults to a different binding type, and I suspect that our Tallyfern SSO configuration may need to be updated to match. Could you confirm which bindings Tallyfern supports and help us update our configuration if necessary? Thank you very much, Graham Holloway

subject: Our account has been breached
body: Someone accessed our account overnight, exported our entire client list and changed our payout details. We've revoked their access but we have over a thousand staff and clients exposed. I need an incident contact now. Rebecca Tan, CISO

subject: Our merger needs Tallyfern capacity
body: Our merger with Lindqvist Partners completes on the 1st and their 380 people will be joining our Tallyfern account. I raised this with your team six weeks ago and I'm still waiting for a revised agreement. We are a 1,252-user customer and I expect this to be treated as a priority. Send me pricing and the paperwork this week. Their staff will also need to be on our single sign-on from day one, so confirm that too.

subject: Help with my old v1 integration
body: Hi there, I'm a solo developer who built a small tool years ago that pulls payment data from Tallyfern using the v1 API. Since last week, GET /v1/payments has started returning amounts as strings instead of numbers, which breaks my calculations. I'd rather not rebuild everything on the newer version right now. Is this change permanant, and is there a way to get the old format back? Thanks so much, Kai

subject: Give us back the $1,996
body: The $1,996 you took for the "growth package" was never approved. We're 28 users on Pro and nobody here ordered it. Return it to our card. Thanks, Simone Harris, Office Manager

subject: Tallyfern down for our whole company
body: Since 9am Singapore time our entire company has been unable to use Tallyfern. The dashboard won't load, and our customers are telling us the payment pages on their invoices are broken. We have over 250 staff sitting idle. Your status page says nothing. I want an update immediately and an ETA. This is unacceptable for an enterprise customer. Kenneth Ong, Operations Director

subject: Locked out of my account
body: Locked out after too many login attempts. I mistyped my password a few times, nothing suspicious. I'm the only user on my free account. Please unlock it or send a reset link so I can send invoices today. Thank you, Aino

subject: Unfamiliar sign-ins on our admin account
body: Hello, our security team has noticed sign-ins to one of our Tallyfern admin accounts from locations where we have no staff, and the account's recovery email was changed yesterday without anyone on our side requesting it. We've reset the password and restored the recovery email, but we'd like your help confirming whether any data was accessed and whether there are other signs of compromise. Thank you, Johannes Becker, Information Security

subject: API problem and a question about our bill
body: Hello, I'm hoping you can help with two things. First, my little integration that creates invoices through your API has started getting a 400 error saying "invalid discount format" whenever I include a percentage discount, even though fixed discounts work fine. Is there a new way to send percentage discounts? Second, our last Tallyfern bill has a line called "API access" that I haven't seen before, and I'd love to know what it is. Thank you very much, Elodie

subject: Questions about API errors in our ERP sync
body: Hello, our ERP system syncs invoices to Tallyfern through your API every hour, and over the past few days we've seen intermittent 409 errors with the message "invoice number already exists", even for invoice numbers that, as far as we can tell, haven't been used before. It seems to happen mostly when two syncs overlap. Could you help us understand how invoice number uniqueness is checked, and whether there's a recommended way to avoid conflicts? Thank you, Andrew Bell, ERP Team

subject: SSO users seeing access errors
body: Since 6am Eastern, a large share of our 1,968 users get "access denied" from Tallyfern after authenticating with our identity provider. No configuration changes on our side. Users who signed in before 6am and kept their sessions open are unaffected. Please check our SSO connection and advise. Our identity provider shows every authentication as successful, so the rejection seems to happen on the Tallyfern side. Regards, Marcus Lee, Identity Services

subject: Your password reset is broken
body: I've been trying to get back into my account for three days. I click "forgot password", I get the email, I click the link, I set a new password, and then the login page tells me the password is incorrect. I've done this five times. I've tried different browsers, cleared my cache, used incognito mode, everything your help articles suggest. I'm the finance lead for a team of over eight hundred people on this account, and I can't approve a single invoice while I'm locked out. Your chat support keeps telling me to "try again later". I want someone who actually understands your login system to look at my account today, and I want to know why your reset process doesn't work. Michael Stern

subject: I think someone has been using our account
body: Hi, I'm hoping you can help, because I'm quite worried. I run a small marketing agency with 35 people, and this morning one of our clients called to ask about an invoice we'd supposedly sent them yesterday, asking them to pay a deposit into a new bank account. We never sent that invoice. When I logged in to check, I found the invoice in our sent folder, along with two others to different clients, all with the same unfamiliar bank details. Our activity log shows they were created by one of our own user accounts, but that person was on holiday yesterday and says they haven't logged in for a week. I've disabled that user and reset everyone's passwords, but I'm not sure how they got in or whether they've done anything else. Could you help me investigate and secure our account? Thanks, Claire Whitman

subject: Staff locked out, fix this
body: About twenty of our staff can't log in since yesterday. Some get no password reset email, others are stuck at our company sign-in page. Nobody has explained why. Fix it today. Henrik Olsen, IT Lead

subject: Is Tallyfern down for everyone?
body: Nothing works. I can't open Tallyfern, my clients can't pay their invoices, and the app on my phone just says it can't connect. It's been like this for an hour. I've checked my internet and it's fine. There's three of us and we can't do anything. When is it going to be fixed? I have invoices to send today and clients waiting. Kim Ashford, Ashford Cleanng Services. Please hurry, this is really stressfull.

subject: I want to see everything you hold on us
body: After that data breach story in the news about another invoicing company, I want to know exactly what Tallyfern has on us. Every record about our company, our 50 staff, our clients, logs, notes, the lot. Send it all to me in a readable form. I'm not interested in a dashboard export, I want what you actually hold. Confirm when I'll get it. Markus Weber

subject: SSO and password problems
body: Some staff can't get in since this morning. Password reset not arriving for some, others loop after our company sign-in. 72 users on our account. Please investigate. Regards, Tom Hughes, IT

subject: Phishing site impersonating Tallyfern
body: Hello, several of our staff received emails this morning directing them to a fake Tallyfern login page. At least one person entered their credentials before we caught it. Could you help us check for any unauthorised access and take down the site? Thank you, Olivia Martin, Security Operations

subject: Payout details changed and invoices edited
body: Hello, Yesterday afternoon I received an email from Tallyfern confirming that our payout bank account had been updated. I didn't make that change, and when I asked my business partner and our bookkeeper, neither of them had either. When I logged in, I saw that the payout account had indeed been switched to an account at a bank we don't use. I also noticed that three of our open invoices had been edited to show the same new bank details for payment. The activity log shows the changes were made from a location in another country, at a time when all 21 of us were offline. I've changed the payout account back and reset all our passwords, but I'm worried about our next payout. Could you please help secure the account and check what else was changed? Thank you, Peter Hall

subject: Payout of $3,242 still missing
body: Our payout of $3,242 has been "in transit" for six days. Your help page says two business days. Our bank has nothing. I've chased your chat twice and been told to wait. I'm done waiting. Find the money and get it into our acount this week, and tell me what's going on with your payouts. Sixteen of us rely on this cash flow. Hugo Laurent

subject: Help with a client's chargeback
body: Hello, I'm hoping you can advise us on a chargeback, as it's the first one we've ever had. We're a small events company in Dublin with 29 staff, and back in June one of our corporate clients paid a $2,946 invoice through Tallyfern for a conference we organised. The event went really well, and we received great feedback afterwards. However, this morning we received a notification that the client has filed a chargeback with their card provider. We've reached out to our contact at the company, but they've been on leave and we haven't heard back yet. We have the signed contract, the delivery confirmations and the feedback emails. Could you explain what happens to the funds while the chargeback is open, what evidence we should submit, and how long we have to respond? We'd really like to resolve this quickly. Many thanks, Siobhán Murphy. Apologies for any errers, I'm writing this in a hurry.

subject: Question about my invoice and plans
body: Hi, I noticed that my last two Tallyfern bills were for different amounts, even though I'm on the free plan with just me and my partner using it. Invoice 1043 shows a small fee that 1044 doesn't. Could you explain what that fee is for? Also, I'm thinking about moving to the Starter plan next month, and I'd love to know what changes. Thanks so much, Abby. Sorry if these are basic qustions.

subject: Our data request has been ignored
body: Five weeks ago, our Data Protection Officer submitted a formal request for a copy of all personal data Tallyfern holds about our organisation's users. We have over fifteen hundred staff on this account. We've had nothing but an acknowledgement. This is now past the legal deadline. I need the data delivered this week and an explanation for the delay. Nigel Ashworth, General Counsel

subject: Locked out, no unusual activity
body: Locked out after failed logins while on a train with poor signal. Colleague checked, account activity normal. Please unlock or send a reset link. I approve supplier invoices for my department and there's a backlog building up. Regards, Pierre Gagnon

subject: Locked out after a password manager mix-up
body: Hello, this morning I was locked out of my Tallyfern account after several failed login attempts. I think what happened is that my password manager filled in an old password after I updated it last week. I've asked a colleague to check our account, and there's nothing unusual: no new users or changes. Could you please unlock my account? Thank you so much, Ananya Sharma. Sorry for the trouble, my mistke entirely.

subject: Setting up approval workflows across departments
body: Hello, I'm the finance systems manager at Brightwater Health, and we're looking to tighten up our invoice approval process in Tallyfern. At the moment, any of our 915 users can send an invoice straight to a client, which has led to a few embarrassing mistakes. Ideally, we'd like invoices over $5,000 to require approval from a department head, and invoices over $25,000 to require a second approval from our finance director. We'd also like different approvers for each of our six departments. I've looked through the settings and found a basic approvals toggle, but I can't see how to set thresholds or assign approvers by department. Is this possible in Tallyfern, and if so, could you point me to the right documentation or walk me through the setup? Thank you, Rachel Kim

subject: Unrecognised logins and changed details
body: Hello, I received alerts this week about sign-ins to my account from a country I've never visited, and today I noticed that my profile phone number had been changed without my knowledge. I've reset my password and restored my number, but I'd like help checking whether anything else was accessed or changed. Our team of 47 shares client data in Tallyfern, so I'm worried about what might have been seen. Thank you, Anna Kowalczyk

subject: Refund request for a training workshop
body: Hello, and thanks in advance for your help. I'm writing about a charge on our account from 27 days ago. We were charged $139 for an online training workshop that one of our staff signed up for, thinking it was included in our plan. Unfortunately, she fell ill on the day and couldn't attend, and when we tried to rebook, we were told the workshop series had ended. We're a small team of six at a family-run garden centre, so we're careful with every expense, and we'd be grateful if the $139 could be refunded to our card on file. I've attached the booking confirmation, which shows she registered but never joined the session. If a refund isn't possible, perhaps a credit towards a future workshop would work instead. Thank you very much for considering this, Margaret Hughes

subject: v1 API failures are hurting our billing
body: Your v1 API has been failing intermittently for three days. Around one in five calls to POST /v1/invoices returns a 502, and our retries pile up during our busy morning run. We have over a thousand people relying on this integration. I've raised it twice and got nothing useful back. I need an engineer to look at this today and tell us what's going on with v1. Victor Hayes, Head of Engineering

subject: Company login keeps kicking people out
body: Our people get thrown back to the start after our company login screen since 7am. About 980 of them. Badge reader outage on Monday was unrelated. Fix this now. Sam Porter, IT Director

subject: Understanding our invoice after the restructure
body: Hello, I'm the procurement lead at Altmann Group, and I'm hoping someone can help me make sense of our latest Tallyfern invoice. Earlier this year, we restructured our organisation into three business units, and at the same time we asked for our users to be split into separate cost centres on our invoice. The invoice we received this month does show three cost centres, but the totals don't seem to match the number of users in each unit, and there's a new line called "cost centre management" that I wasn't expecting. We currently have around 1,500 users across the three units. I'm not disputing anything at this stage, I'd just like to understand how the totals were calculated and what the new line covers, so that I can explain it to our finance team. Thank you, Katrin Altmann

subject: Planning our renewal and expansion
body: Hi, hope things are good on your end. I'm the head of business technology at Harborview Financial, and I'm starting to plan our Tallyfern renewal, which is due early next year. We currently have 1,581 people on our enterprise plan, and over the next twelve months we expect that number to grow significantly, partly because we're opening offices in two new cities and partly because we're bringing our wealth management division onto the platform. Our best estimate is that we'll need somewhere between 2,100 and 2,300 seats by the end of next year. I'd like to explore a renewal agreement that accommodates that growth, ideally with predictable pricing as we add seats, and I'd also like to understand whether a multi-year commitment would bring any benefits. Could we set up a meeting with the right person in the next few weeks? Thank you, Jonathan Avery

subject: Our seat reduction request has been ignored
body: I'm writing for the third time about reducing our enterprise seats, and I'm running out of patience. After a reorganisation, we need to go from 1,636 seats to about 1,200 at our renewal, which is now less than a month away. I first raised this with our account contact in July, then again through your support portal in August, and both times I was told someone would be in touch "shortly". Nobody has been in touch. If I don't receive a revised contract reflecting the reduction before our renewal date, we will not be renewing at all, and we'll move our entire organisation to another provider. I'd like a named person responsible for our account, a written quote for 1,200 seats, and confirmation of how the reduction will be applied, by the end of this week. Ingrid Sørensen, Chief Operating Officer

subject: Can't sign in plus a billing question
body: Can't sign in since Tuesday, reset emails never arrive. Need access to send invoices. Also, why did our last bill go from $89 to $112? Same five users, same plan since 2023. Explain please. Thanks, Nora, Lakeview Tutoring

subject: Payout arrived short this week
body: Hello, hope all is well on your side. I'm writing from the treasury team at Kingsmere Housing. Our weekly payout arrived yesterday, but it was $1,881 less than the total shown in the Tallyfern dashboard. We've gone through the payout breakdown line by line and can't see any fees, refunds or holds that would account for the difference. Could you look into where the missing $1,881 went and whether it will be paid separately? Many thanks, Oliver Chambers

subject: Request to delete our data
body: Hello, we're closing our small studio and would like Tallyfern to delete all the personal data you hold about us and our two users. Please let me know if you need anything to verify our identity, and confirm once it's done. Thank you, Elisa Romano

subject: Small refund for a template pack
body: Hello, hope all is good. This is a small one, but I wanted to raise it anyway. Exactly 30 days ago, one of our team members bought a $20 invoice template pack while exploring the design settings, not realising it wasn't included in our enterprise plan. We already have our own branded templates, so we'll never use it. Would it be possible to refund the $20? I know it's minor, but our procurement rules require every purchase to be approved in advance. Thanks, Laura Mitchell

subject: Adding a handful of seats
body: We're on Pro with 48 seats and need to add four more for new starters next month. Settings page won't let me add them myself. Can you add them, or tell me how? Also want to know if the price per seat changes. Please reply by Friday as we need to issue logins on Monday. Thanks, Anders Holm, Holm & Berg

subject: v1 API rejecting our requests
body: Hello, since this morning our small integration gets a 401 error on every request to the v1 API, even though our key hasn't changed. Could you check if something changed for v1 authentcation? Thank you, Marek, Nowak Furniture

subject: Payout of $9,885 failed and nobody told us
body: I'm writing because I've had enough of finding out about problems from my bank instead of from you. Our payout of $9,885 was supposed to land on Monday. When it didn't, I called our bank, who told me there had been no incoming transfer at all. Only then did I log in to Tallyfern and discover that the payout had "failed" days ago, with no email, no notification, and no explanation. Our bank details are exactly the same as they've been for three years. I run a small physiotherapy clinic with nine staff, and that money covers our rent and wages this month. I want to know exactly why the payout failed, when it will be resent, and why nobody thought to tell us. If this happens again, we'll be moving to another provider. Rachel Dunn

subject: Client filed a bank dispute instead of a refund
body: Hello, I'm hoping you can help me understand what's going on, because I'm a bit lost. Back on 21 June, one of our clients paid a $745 invoice through Tallyfern for a series of photography sessions. A couple of weeks ago she mentioned she wasn't happy with one of the sessions, and I offered her a partial refund, but before I could arrange it, she filed a dispute with her bank over the whole payment. Now I've received a notice from you about the dispute, and I'm not sure whether I can still refund her directly or whether I have to wait for the bank to decide. We're a small studio with eight people, so I'd really like to sort this out fairly and quickly. Could you explain my options and what evidence I should send? Thank you so much, Nina Bauer

subject: Adding seats to our plan
body: Pro plan, 46 seats. Need 3 more next week. How do I add them, and does the price change? Settings page says to contact support. Please sort it quickly, new hires start Monday. Thanks, Ravi Menon

subject: $10,804 payout failed!
body: My $10,804 payout failed and I only found out because my bank had nothing. That's the biggest payment my business has ever received. Bank details haven't changed. Fix it and get the money to me tomorrow. Zoe Turner, Turner Events

body: A week ago your dashboard said our payout of $5,122 was sent. It still isn't in our bank account. Our bank has no record of it. I've asked your chat twice and been told to wait. I've waited. I need a trace reference and the money in our account by Friday, and an explanation of why this keeps happening. We're a team of 50 and we can't run payroll on promises. Henrik Larsen

subject: Where is our seat expansion quote?
body: We asked three weeks ago to expand our enterprise account from 512 to 650 seats. We've had one automated reply. Our new team starts in ten days and they need access on day one. Send the quote and contract amendment by Friday, and assign us a contact who actually replies. This is not the service we were promised. Laura Grant, VP Operations

body: Since Saturday our warehouse system's link to Tallyfern fails on every invoice it creates. The error says "customer address missing", but addresses are filled in. We haven't changed anything. 39 users waiting on invoices. What changed on your side? Need a fix today. Please also confirm whether other customers are seeing the same thing, and whether we should hold off sending until it's fixed. Thanks, Gareth Holmes

subject: Refund for a charge from 32 days ago
body: Hello, I hope you've had a good start to the week. I'm writing about a charge we noticed during our monthly expense review. Thirty-two days ago, our account was charged for an annual upgrade to the premium reporting tier. As far as we can tell, it was switched on automatically when a free trial ended, but nobody on our team remembers agreeing to a paid upgrade, and none of our twelve users has used the premium reports since. I understand the charge was over a month ago, and I'm sorry we didn't catch it sooner, but our office manager was on leave and the statements piled up. Could you please refund the charge and return us to our previous plan? I'd also appreciate it if future trials could notify us before they convert. Thank you, Olivia Bennett

subject: Delete our former staff data now
body: I've asked twice for the personal data of our former employees to be deleted from Tallyfern. They left months ago and have made formal requests to us. Delete it this week and confirm in writing. Not acceptible that this is still pending. Sabine Keller, HR Director

subject: Somebody else is in my account
body: Someone changed my password and the email on my account last night, and I only got back in because the reset link still came to my phone. Now I can see a payout I didn't set up, scheduled to go to a bank I've never heard of. I'm one of seven people on this acount and none of us did this. I want the payout cancelled, the account locked, and an explanation of how this happened. Right now, please. Jordan Hale

subject: Planning our expansion for next year
body: Hello, I hope you're doing well. I'm the director of finance systems at Lakeshore Health Partners, and I'm reaching out to start planning our Tallyfern contract for next year. We currently have 1,981 people on our enterprise plan, and our growth plans include bringing two newly acquired hospitals onto the platform, which would add roughly 600 users over the first half of the year. I'd like to understand how our agreement could accommodate that growth, whether we can phase in the new seats as each hospital joins, and how pricing would work at that scale. We'd also like to discuss whether a three-year term would make sense for us. Could we arrange a call with someone from your team in the next couple of weeks? Thank you, Diane Foster

subject: Explain our bill, and someone accessed our account
body: First, I want a proper explanation of our latest Tallyfern invoice. It's almost twice what we usually pay, and nobody here can work out why. Our seat count hasn't changed, and we haven't bought any add-ons. Second, and this is the bit that really worries me: while I was looking into the bill, I noticed that the email address on our account had been changed last week to one I've never seen, and that someone had added a new payout account. None of us made those changes, and we're only ten people, so I'd know. I've changed the email back and removed the payout account, but I have no idea who did this or what else they looked at. I want someone to investigate the access imediately and get back to me today, and then explain the invoice. This is really not good enough. Marcus Webb

subject: How do I get a copy of my data?
body: Hiya! I'm a freelance web designer and I've been using Tallyfern's free plan for my invoicing for a few years now. I'm doing a bit of a digital clean-up, and I realised I've never asked any of my software providers what information they keep about me. So I'd like to request a copy of everything Tallyfern holds about me and my business partner, including our account details, invoices and client info. How does that work? Thanks, Casey

subject: Seat reduction at renewal
body: Hello, as part of a restructuring, we'd like to reduce our enterprise seats from 1,283 to around 1,000 at our upcoming renewal. Could you please send a revised quote and confirm how the reduction would be applied? We'd also like to understand any minimum commitments in our current agreement before we finalise anything. Our renewal date is in about six weeks, so we'd appreciate a reply soon. Thank you, Michelle Ng, Business Operations

subject: Add seats to our Pro plan
body: We have 46 seats on Pro and need 3 more for new hires. The settings page errors when I try to add them myself. Can you add them, or tell me what's wrong with the page? Also, does adding seats change our billing date? Need this done before Monday, when our new starters arrive. We may need a few more later in the year as well. Thanks, Peter Lam, Lam Associates

subject: Growing team and seat pricing questions
body: Hello, lovely people! I'm the office manager at a busy design consultancy in Singapore, and I wanted to ask about our seats. We're currently at 53 on the Pro plan, and we've got a few new projects starting next quarter that mean we'll probably hire another ten or fifteen people. I'm trying to put together a budget for our directors, and I'd love to understand how the pricing works as we add more seats, whether there's a discount once we pass a certian size, and whether it would make sense to switch to annual billing. I'd also like to know whether we can add seats gradually as people join, rather than all at once. Could someone walk me through the options, or send me a quote for around 65 to 70 seats? Thanks so much, Priya Raman. Apologies if this isn't the right departmnet.

subject: Tallyfern down again, this is ridiculous
body: Your platform is down AGAIN. Since 2pm CET none of our 30 staff can load the dashboard, and our clients are telling us the payment pages on their invoices are broken. Your status page says everything is fine, which it clearly isn't. I need an update and an ETA right now. This is the third time this quarter and it's costing us money every hour. Explain what's going on. Lukas Fischer. Absolutley fed up.

subject: Customer filed a chargeback over $133
body: One of our customers has filed a chargeback over a $133 payment they made through our Tallyfern invoice. They never contacted us with any complaint, and we have proof the service was delivered. I'm furious that someone can do this without even talking to us first. Tell me exactly how to contest it and how long I have. James Holloway, Holloway Property Services

body: Your v1 API is failing again. Since yesterday, every call to GET /v1/invoices returns a 503 for about ten minutes every hour, like clockwork. We're a small team of eight and I can't babysit your API all day. Aiden Clarke

subject: Refund for the add-on bought on 5 September
body: Hello, on 5 September one of our team bought the $395 advanced reporting add-on, thinking it was a trial. It turns out it was a full annual purchase, and we don't really need it. Nobody has used it since. Could we have the $395 refunded to our card, please? I'm happy to provide any details that would help. Thank you, Elena Popescu

subject: Request to delete our data
body: Please delete all personal data Tallyfern holds about our company and our 27 users. We're closing our account at month end. Confirm when done, and let us know if anything has to be kept for legal reasons and for how long. We'd like it in writing for our files. Thanks, Brian Kelly, Kelly Landscaping

subject: Everything is broken and your status page lies
body: I'm writing because your entire platform appears to have been down for the last hour, and your status page still claims that everything is operational. Since about 10am AEST, every request our system makes to the Tallyfern API fails with a 503, regardless of the endpoint. The dashboard won't load for any of our seventeen staff, and our customers are emailing to say the payment links on their invoices go to an error page. We've checked our own systems thoroughly and the problem is definitely not on our side. This is a busy time for us and we're losing payments every minute this goes on. I want an honest update on what's happening, an estimated time for when things will be working again, and afterwards an explanation of why your status page didn't reflect the outage. Matt Robinson, Robinson Freight

subject: Refund a charge and explain this invoice
body: I'm writing about two things, and I'm not happy about either. First, nine days ago we were charged for an annual premium support upgrade that nobody here asked for. Our enterprise contract already includes support, so I want that charge refunded in full. Second, I want an explanation of the "platform fee" on our last invoice, which went up from $300 to $450 without any notice. We have 125 people on this account and our finance team needs every line explained before they'll approve payment. I've already spent two days going back and forth with your billing chat, which kept sending me links to help articles that don't answer either question. Please refund the support upgrade and send me a written breakdown of the platform fee by the end of this week. Frankly, I expected better from a supplier we pay this much. Alicia Turner, Finance Director

On Monday, one of our clients emailed to thank us for "the new payment details", which we never sent. On Tuesday, I noticed that our invoice template now shows a different bank account in the footer, and nobody on our team of fifteen remembers changing it. Then this morning I got an email from Tallyfern saying our notification address had been updated, again by nobody here. I've changed the bank details back and reset my password, but I'm worried that someone outside the company has got into our account and is trying to redirect our clients' payments. Could you please check what's been changed and by whom, and help me make sure no one else can get in? Thank you, Hannah Price

subject: Chargeback on a recent client payment
body: Hello, I'm reaching out from the accounts team at Pinecrest Medical Group. Five days ago, one of our corporate clients paid a $2,375 invoice through Tallyfern for occupational health services we provided in August. This morning we received a notification that the client has filed a chargeback with their card provider. We've contacted the client, and it appears their finance team didn't recognise our name on the card statement and raised the chargeback as a precauton. They've said they're happy to withdraw it, but we'd like to understand the process from our side. Will the funds be held while the chargeback is open, and is there anything we need to submit to resolve it quickly? We have over eleven hundred people on our account and this is the first time it's happened, so any guidance would be appreciated. Thank you, Karen Mitchell

subject: Tiny refund for a mistaken purchase
body: Hi there, I hope you don't mind me writing about something so small. Three days ago I was setting up my invoices for the first time, and while I was looking at the different invoice designs, I accidentally bought a premium template for $25. I'm a sole trader who makes handmade jewellery, and my partner helps me with the books, so we're the only two people on the account. I didn't realise the template wasn't free until I saw the charge on my bank app. I haven't used it on any invoices, and to be honest, the free templates are lovely and do everything I need. Would it be possible to refund the $25? It's not a huge amount, but every little bit counts when you're just starting out. Thank you so much for your help, Lily Chen

subject: Your charge is being disputed with our bank
body: I'm writing to tell you that we've opened a dispute with our bank over the $1,586 you charged us on 22 July, which was 79 days ago. That charge was for a "data migration service" we never requested and never received. I contacted your billing team three times about it, and each time I was told someone would get back to me. Nobody did. I would much rather have had a refund, but after two months of being ignored, the bank dispute was the only option left. Now I'm getting automated emails warning that our account may be restricted. We have 58 people who rely on Tallyfern daily, so any restriction would be a serious problem for us. If you want to resolve this, contact me directly, explain why we were charged, and refund the money properly. Fiona Gallagher, Managing Director

If so, how do we configure it, and can users be restricted to one entity? We have 1,851 users across the entities. Please send setup instructions or a link to the right documentation. Regards, Li Wei, Finance Systems

subject: The little charge on the 6th
body: Greetings! I'm a one-woman ceramics studio in Auckland, and I've been using Tallyfern for my invoicing since March. On the 6th I noticed a $46 charge from you on my card statement, labelled "invoice design pack". I think it happened when I was trying out different invoice layouts for my autumn collection, which has 24 new pieces, and I must have clicked on a premium one without realising. I haven't actually used it on any of my invoices, and the free designs suit me perfectly well. Would you be able to give me the $46 back? I know it's not a fortune, but it would pay for a bag of clay! Sorry for the bother, and thank you for making invoicing so much easier for little businesses like mine. Warm regards, Aroha Wiremu. Ps, my order number is 3381 if that helps, apologies if I've mispelled anything.

subject: Wondering how to get a copy of our data

subject: Puzzled by the numbers on our statement
body: Hello, I hope this finds you well. I'm the practice manager at a small veterinary group in York, and I've been trying to make sense of the statements we receive from Tallyfern each month. We have 24 people on our account, and our plan hasn't changed in over a year, but the total seems to creep up a little every few months, and this month there's a line called "service adjustment" that I've never come across. I'm not complaining about the cost as such, and I'm certainly not asking for anything back. I'd simply like to understand how each line is worked out, whether there's been a price change I missed, and whether the "service adjustment" will keep appearing. Our partners have asked me to explain it at our next meeting, and at the moment I'm stumped. Thank you very much for any help, Judith Barnes. Sorry if I've used the wrong terminolgy.
